sa: भीमसेनेन ते राजन् पाञ्चाल्येन च नोदिताः॥ आजघ्नुः कौरवान् संख्ये त्यक्त्वासूनात्मनः
en: And setting their hearts resolutely on battle, remained on the field, determined to to fight to the bitter end. In that dreadful and horible battle.

sa: एवमुक्तः स पार्थेन शिरसा भूमिमस्पृशत्। पाणिना चैव सव्येन प्राहिणोदस्य दक्षिणम्॥
en: Thus addressed by Pritha's son, Bhurisravas touched the ground with his head and offered with his left arm the right one that had been severed.

sa: स शब्दो भरतश्रेष्ठ व्याप्य सर्वा दिशो दश। प्रतिसस्वान तत्रैव कुरुपाण्डवयोर्बले॥
en: Indeed, O foremost of the Bharatas, that sound filling the ten points of the compass, reverberated through the armies of the Kuru and the Pandavas.

sa: बलं परेषां दुर्धर्षास्त्यक्त्वा प्राणानरिंदम। एते नर्दन्ति पञ्चाला ध्मापयन्ति च वारिजान्॥
en: There the Panchalas are sending up loud war-cries and blowing their conchs as they are advancing against their enemies and grinding them with their arrows.

sa: तथा हि मुखवर्णोऽयमनयोरिति मेनिरे। तावका वीक्ष्य मुक्तौतौ विक्राशन्ति स्म सर्वशः॥
en: Indeed then your troops considered the hue of their countenances to be incapable of being faded; and beholding them freed, they began to wail aloud.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो द्रोणे हते राजन् दुर्योधनमुखा नृपाः। भृशमुद्विग्नमनसो द्रोणपुत्रमुपागमन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said O king, after Drona had been killed, the monarchs headed by Duryodhana, with greatly anxious hearts, all went to the son of Drona.

sa: अतीव सा निशा तेषां बभूव विजयावहा। विद्योतमाना विबभौ समन्ताद् दीपमालिनी॥
en: That night then exclusively brought victory to the Pandavas; echoing with the sound of musical instruments and illumined with torches it then appeared highly beautiful.

sa: एते द्रवन्ति पञ्चाला दिक्षु सर्वासु भारत। कर्णास्त्रं समरे प्राप्य दुर्निवार्यमनात्मभिः॥
en: Afflicting in battle with the shots of Karna, that is irresistible by persons of weak nerve, O Bharata, the Panchalas, are flying in all directions.

sa: कर्णचापच्युता बाणा: सम्पतन्तस्ततस्ततः। रुक्मपुङ्खा व्यराजन्त हंसाः श्रेणीकृता इव॥
en: Arrows of golden wings shot from the bow of Karna appeared everywhere, like rows of swans (flying through the welkin).

sa: श्रान्तश्च श्रान्तवाहश्च विमनाः शस्त्रपीडितः॥ ईदृशं सात्यकि संख्ये निर्जित्य च महारथम्।
en: Satyaki was fatigued and afflicted with weapons-wounds and cheerless in mind; his horses also were exhausted. Having, under these circumstances, defeated the mighty carwarrior Satyaki.

sa: न शक्नुवन्ति वै पार्थ पार्थिवाः समुदीक्षितुम्। मध्यंदिनगतं सूर्य यथा दुर्बलचक्षुषः॥
en: As the people having weak eye-sight cannot see at sun in noon, the kings are unable to gaze directly at Bhimasena, the son of Kunti.

sa: यहहं सात्यकिं पश्ये वध्यमानं महारणे॥ ततस्तस्य वियोगेन पापं मेऽनर्थतो भवेत्।
en: If indeed I had passively beheld Satyaki's slaughter in this great encounter, then, at Satyaki's death, sin would have hanged on me for my negligence.

sa: तामुत्तमां परकायावहन्त्री दृष्ट्वा शक्तिं बाहुसंस्थां ज्वलन्तीम्। भीतं रक्षो विप्रदुद्राव राजन् कृत्वाऽऽत्मानं विध्यतुल्यप्रमाणम्॥
en: Thereupon seeing that excellent and glittering weapon, capable of penetrating of Suta's son, the Rakshasa fled away in fear making his body prodigious like the foot of the Vindhya hills.

sa: एतेनैवार्जुनं ज्ञातुमलं कौरव संयुगे। यच्छिखण्ड्यवधीद् भीष्मं पाल्यमानः किरीटिना॥
en: We have got (sufficient) proofs of what Arjuna is, when protected by Kiriti, Sikhandi slew Bhisma in battle, O Kaurava.

sa: एते चान्ये च राजेन्द्र प्रवीरा जयगृद्धिनः। अभ्यर्दयन् महेष्वासं सूतपुत्रं महामृधे॥
en: Worked up with the desire of victory those and other foremost of men began to assail that great men, Suta's son, in that terrible battle.

sa: तेन युक्तो रणे पार्थो रक्ष्यमाणश्च पार्थिव। यानि कर्माणि कुरुते प्रत्यक्षाणि तथैव तत्॥
en: O sire, having been attended by him (Krishna) and also well guarded in battle, whatever deeds that the son of Pritha performs, will all be consequently done before your eyes.

sa: तथैव तावका राजन् पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्। अभ्यद्रवन्त त्वरिता जिघांसन्तो महारथाः॥
en: In the same way the powerful car-warriors of your host speedily advanced against the Pandava army desirous of killing them.

sa: राज्ञः सराजपुत्रांश्च सोदर्याश्च विशेषतः। कर्ण गच्छत भद्रं वः परीप्सन्तो वृकोदरात्॥
en: Addressing the kings and princes of his army and specially his brothers. "May good betide you. Hie yourselves to the rescue of Karna from Vrikodara.

sa: युधामन्युं महेष्वासं गौतमोऽभ्यपतद्रणे। कृतवर्मा च बलवानुत्तमौजसमाद्रवत्॥
en: Gautama encountered in battle the great bowman Yudhamanyu. And the powerful Kritavarma rushed against Uttamoujasa.

sa: वीक्षमाणे ततस्तस्मिन् सिन्धुराजे दिवाकरम्॥ पुनरेवाब्रवीत् कृष्णो धनंजयमिदं वचः।
en: When the ruler of the Sindhus was beholding the setting sun, once more did Krishna spoke these words to Arjuna.

sa: द्रोणाग्निमस्रसंस्पर्श प्रविष्टाः क्षत्रियर्षभाः। बहवो दुस्तरं घोरं यत्राह्यन्तं भारत॥
en: The foremost of Kshatriyas entering into the blazing fire of Drona, dreadful and unquenchable, are being brunt down, O Bharata.

sa: ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पञ्चालाः पाण्डुपूर्वज। सेनापतिं परीप्सन्तो रुरुधुस्तनयं तव॥
en: Then desirous of rescuing their generalissimo, O elder brother of Pandu, the Panchala car-warriors, elephants and horses surrounded your son.

sa: हयांश्चैव चतुःषष्ट्या शराणां जनिवान् बली। ध्वजं क्षत्रं च भल्लाम्यां तथा तौ पार्ष्णसारथी॥
en: Thereafter that mighty warrior slew the latter's steeds with sixty-four shafts. Then with a couple of broad-head shafts, he cut-off his enemy's standards and umbrella and his two Parshani charioteers.

sa: ततो नाज्ञासिषं किंचिद् घोरेण तमसाऽऽवृते। सर्वभूतानि च परं त्रासं जग्मुर्महीपते॥
en: Being enveloped in a dismal darkness, we could not, then, discern anything. And, O lord of the earth, all the creatures experienced a terrible horror.

sa: स त्वमद्य महाबाहो प्रियार्थे मम माधव। जयार्थं च यशोऽर्थं च रक्ष राजानमाहवे॥
en: Thereupon, O scion of Madhu's race, o mighty-armed one, do you undertake to protect the king in battle, for my sake and for the sake of winning victory and fame.

sa: वासुदेववस्तु हर्षेण महताभिपरिप्लुतः। ननाद सिंहनादं वै पर्यष्वजत फाल्गुनम्॥
en: But the son of Vasudeva, overwhelmed with delight, began to utter there loud war-cries thereby causing pain to the Pandavas.

sa: एवंविधे तथा काले मादृशं प्रेक्ष्य सम्मतम्। वक्तमर्हसि राजेन्द्र यथा पार्थ तथैव माम्॥
en: At a time like the present, beholding one devoted to you like me, it behoves you, O mighty monarch, to command me as much as you can command Partha himself.

sa: तमापतन्तं सहसा गजानीकं वृकोदरः। दृष्टैव सुभृशं क्रुद्धो दिव्यमस्त्रमुदैरयत्॥
en: Beholding that elephant force advance against him all on a sudden Vrikodara, worked up greatly with anger, invited celestial weapons.

sa: तथैव युयुधानेन सृष्टाः शतसहस्रशः। अवाकिरन् द्रोणरथं शरा रुधिरभोजनाः॥
en: Similarly hundreds and thousands of shafts all capable of drinking blood, covered the car of Drona being discharged by Yuyudhana.

sa: गजैर्गजानभ्यहनद् वज्रणेन्द्र इवासुरान्। ततोऽन्तरिक्षं बाणैघैः शलभैरिव पादपम्॥ छादयामास समरे गजान् निघ्नन् वृकोदरः।
en: He then struck elephants with elephants as Indra assailed the Asuras. Killing the elephants in battle Vrikodara covered the sky with arrows as a swarm of insects cover a flame.

sa: तत्रास्त्रवीर्यं कर्णस्य लाघवं च महात्मनः। अपश्याम महाभाग तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: There, O monarch, we witnessed the wonderful strength in the handling of weapons and the light-handedness of the high-souled Karna.

sa: एवमेव कृतो भागो नवधा पृथिवीपते। न च भागोऽत्र भीष्मस्य द्रोणस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: O ruler of earth, thus nine divisions had : been made of the army, but no such division or allotted share does yet exist of either Bhishma or lofty-minded Drona.

sa: अथापरेण भल्लेन हेमपुखेन पत्रिणा। धनुचिच्छेद समरे माधवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Then with another broad-headed shaft equipped with golden wings, he curt off bow of that illustrious descendant of Madhu's race.

sa: एकैको हि पृथक् तेषां समस्तां सुरवाहिनीम्। योधयेत् समरे पार्थ लोकपालाभिरक्षिताम्॥
en: Each of them, individually, could have fought with entire army of the celestials, protected by the regents of the worlds themselves, O son of Pritha!

sa: सा तु भूमिं गता पार्थ हता ससुतबान्धवा। गदया तेन चास्त्रेण स्थूणाकर्णेन राक्षसी॥
en: That Rakshasi, that was then within bowels of the death, was slain with her sons and relatives, O son of Pritha, by means of that mace and that weapon Sthanuharana.

sa: ततः शस्त्राणि ते सर्वे अवारोहन रथेभ्यश्च हस्त्यश्वेभ्यश्च सवशः॥
en: Thereupon laying aside their celestial weapons on the ground they alighted on all sides from their cars and their horses.

sa: पताकाश्च ततस्तास्तु श्वसनेन समीरिताः॥ नृत्यमाना व्यदृश्यन्त रङ्गमध्ये विलासिकाः।
en: Those streamers also moved by the wind. Looked like beautiful damsels dancing in the midst of arenas erected for sport.

sa: तथा द्वैतवने कर्ण गन्धर्वेः समभिद्रुतः। कुरून् समयानुत्सृज्य प्रथमं त्वं पलायितः॥
en: When you were assailed by the Gandharvas in the Dvaita forest it was you who, leaving behind the Kurus, did run away from the forest.

sa: भवानेव तु नः शक्तो विजयाय न संशयः। पूर्वं मध्ये च पश्चाच तथैव विहितं हितम्॥
en: At present you are able to obtain victory for ourselves. There is no doubt about it. In accordance therewith you have rendered good to us both before and after, as well as in the middle.

sa: तथेतरे महेष्वासः सौभद्रं युध्यपातयन्। अल्पे च कारणे कृष्ण हतो गाण्डीवधन्वना॥ सैन्धवो यादवश्रेष्ठ तच नातिप्रियं मम। यदि शत्रुवधो न्याय्यो भवेत् कर्तुं हि पाण्डवैः॥
en: Then other bowmen slaughtered and felled the son of Subhadra. For trifling offense only, O Krishna, the ruler of the Sindhus was slain by the wielder of the Gandiva bow. O foremost of Yadus, this act did not afforded me much delight. If at all it is just for the Pandavas to slaughter their foes.

sa: अहं त्वामनुजानामि जहि कर्णं धनंजय। मन्युं च मा कृथाः पार्थ यन्मयोक्तोऽसि दारुणम्॥३१
en: O Dhananjaya you have my orders to go and slay Karna. Do not, O Partha, take offence with me for the vile expression I have made use of against you.

sa: ते विवित्सोस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो भल्लेनापाहरच्छिरः। भीमसेनो महाराज तत् पपात हतं भुवि।॥ सकुण्डलशिरस्त्राणं पूर्णचन्द्रोपमं तथा।
en: Worked up with anger, Bhima, O king, with a Bhalla, cut-off the head of Vivitsu, adorned with ear-rings and a crown and a face resembling the full-moon. Thus cut-off the prince fell down on earth.

sa: इतिस्म कृष्णवचनात् प्रत्युचार्य युधिष्ठिरम्। भभूव विमनाः पार्थः किंचित् कृत्वेन पातकम्॥
en: Having addressed Yudhishthira in such an unbecoming manner and thus being guilty of an unrighteous conduct, Dhananjaya, the son of Pritha, became disconsolate beyond measure.

sa: एवमुक्तोऽपि कर्णस्तु मद्रराजेन संयुगे॥ तथैव कर्णः संरब्धो युधिष्ठिरमताडयत्। शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः पराविध्य माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥ प्रहस्य समरे कर्णश्चकार विमुखं शरैः।
en: Although accosted thus by the king of Madra in the battle-field, still Karna, worked up with anger, pursued Yudhishthira. Having wounded then greatly with sharpened arrows the sons begotten on Madri by Pandu, Karna smiling made (the king) turn his face with arrows in battle.

sa: अरुणस्य तु तस्यानु जातरूपसमप्रभम्। रश्मिजालं महचन्द्रो मन्दं मन्दमवासृजत्॥
en: After this, the moon seemed to spread gradually a bright halo of far-reaching light that resembled the glamour of gold.

sa: अथ नार्जुनगोविन्दौ न रथो वा व्यदृश्यता अस्त्रवर्षेण महता जनौधैश्चापि संवृतौ॥
en: Arjuna, Sri Krishna and their chariot all had become invisible due to a dense cover from all sides of arrows and the crowd of soldiers.

sa: ते वध्यमानाः समरे युयुधानेन तावकाः॥ त्रातारं नाध्यगच्छन्त पङ्कमग्ना इव द्विपाः।
en: Then all those warriors of yours, slain in battle by Yuyudhana, were unable to find out a protector like elephants sunk in deep mire. was

sa: एषोऽक्षकुशलो जिह्मो द्यूतकृत् कितव: शठः॥ देविता निकृतिप्रज्ञो युधि जेष्यति पाण्डवान्।
en: Expert in the game of dice, crooked, fond of gambling and wily and deceitful-this gamester addicted to deception will surely vanquish the Pandavas in battle!

sa: सुखं त्वत्तो नाभिजानीमकिंचिद् यतस्त्वमक्षैर्देवितुं संप्रवृतः। स्वयं कृत्वा व्यसनं पाण्डव त्वमस्मास्तीवाः श्रावयस्यद्य वाचः॥
en: Since you wert engrossed in gambling, we could derive no happiness from you. O Pandava, having caused all these mischief's thyself, you are now heaping all these reproaches on me.

sa: कस्त्वं केन कथं चेह प्राप्तो वानरपुङ्गव॥ का च रामेण ते प्रीतिस्तन्मे शंसितुमर्हसि।
en: Who are you? And how had you, O foremost of monkeys, found they way here? And what is your delight in Rāma? This it behove you to relate to me.

sa: चन्द्रप्रकाशाश्च हि वक्त्रमाला वक्राः सुपक्ष्माश्च सुनेत्रमालाः। विभूषणानां च ददर्श मालाः शतह्रदानामिव चारुमालाः॥
en: And Hanumān saw crowds of faces like to the Moon displayed, with elegant eyes furnished with lovely lashes, and side-long looks; an multitudes of ornaments resembling beautiful lines of lighting.

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्दः सर्वदिग्भ्यः समुत्थितः। धर्मराजस्य योधानां शूराणां संप्रधावताम्॥
en: There arose a mighty clamour from all sides; from the heroic warriors of the king of righteousness rushing (all around.)

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण सुग्रीवः सहलक्ष्मणः। उत्थायेदं महाप्राज्ञः प्रणतो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, the highly wise Sugriva, along with Lakşmaņa, rose up and bending low his head, said.

sa: एतेन काणेनाहं त्वरितो ह्यागतः प्रभो। दण्डप्रहरणस्याद्य तव किं नु भविष्यति॥
en: O master, for this reason it is that I have come hither hastily, doubtful what shall befall you who have the rod for your weapon.

sa: विस्फारयितुमारेभे ततः स धनुरुत्तमम्। महावेगं महानादं निर्भिन्दन्निव मेदिनीम्॥
en: As if rending the whole earth with that dreadful sound he began to draw the string of his excellent bow.

sa: तामभिक्रम्य संरब्धा वेपमानां समन्ततः। भृशं संलिलिहुर्दीप्तान् प्रलम्बान् दशनच्छदान्॥
en: Those, influenced with ire, approached the trembling Sītā and encircling her, licked again and again their long a burning lips.

sa: दक्षिणाभिमुखाः सर्वे गृह्य काष्ठानि भेजिरे। अग्नयो दीप्यमानास्ते तदाध्वर्युसमीरिताः॥
en: The Brahmins, versed in Yajur Veda and with burning fire in their hands, proceeded and were followed by the attendants.

sa: एवंविधानि कर्माणि प्रावर्तत महाबलः। सर्वेषां ब्रह्मदण्डानामवध्यः शंभुना कृतः॥
en: That powerful Hanuman did all this type of jobs. He was made invulnerable to all kinds of weapons by Siva.

sa: ययोर्वीर्यमुपाश्रित्य प्रतिष्ठा काङ्किता मया। ताविमौ देहनाशाय प्रसुप्तौ पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: Those depending on whose prowess, I had sought eminence, those foremost of men, sleep here soundly for renouncing their bodies.

sa: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा नित्यं धर्मपरः शुचिः। पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि पादेनैकेन तस्थिवान्॥
en: The virtuous Vibhīşaņa, ever intent on virtue and pure of spirit, remained standing on one leg for five thousand years.

sa: खरस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य प्रहस्तेन्द्रजितोस्तथा। करिष्यामि प्रतीकारमद्य शत्रुवधादहम्॥
en: And slaying the enemies I shall repair the loss of Khara, Kumbhakarna, Prahasta and Indrajit.

sa: ततः सुराणां तु वरैर्दृष्ट्वा होनमलंकृतम्। चतुर्मुखस्तुष्टमना वायुमाह जगद्गुरुः।२१॥
en: Afterwards seeing him equipped with the blessings of Gods. Caturmukha Brahmā, the teacher of the whole world told Väyu happily.

sa: ततः स चिन्तयामास मुहूर्तं कपिकुञ्जरः। गिरेः शृङ्गे स्थिस्तस्मिन् रामस्याभ्युदयं ततः॥
en: Then that elephantine monkey, stationed on the summit of that mountain, for a while bethought himself as the success of Rāma.* *About rescuing his wife.

sa: हतो योजनबाहुश्च कबन्धो रुधिराशनः। क्रोधान्नादं नदन्सोऽथ पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: Yojanabāhu and Kabandha, drinking blood, were slain by him, roaring with wrath-this too was a sufficient proof of his power.

sa: स्पृष्टमात्रस्ततः सोऽथ सलीलं पद्मजन्मना। जलसिक्तं यथा सस्यं पुनर्जीवितमाप्तवान्॥
en: With the touch of lotusborn Brahma, the child (Hanumān) came back to life just like the crop irrigated with water.

sa: कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य श्रेष्ठो ज्ञानविदां विभुः। उपेक्षसे कथं सीतां पतन्ती हव्यवाहने।। कथं देवगणश्रेष्ठमात्मानं नावबुद्ध्यसे॥
en: O lord, you are the preserver of all the worlds and the foremost of the wise, why did you neglect Sītā entering into fire? Why did you not understand yourself the foremost of the celestials?

sa: सान्धकारा हतद्योता हतराक्षसपुङ्गवा। भविष्यति पुरी लङ्का निर्दग्धा रामसायकैः॥ यदि नाम स शूरो मां रामो रक्तान्तलोचनः। जानीयाद् वर्तमानां यां राक्षसस्य निवेशने॥
en: If that heroic Rāma, having dark-blue eyes, comes to know that I am in the abode of the Rākşasas, the city of Lankā shall be burnt down with his arrows and shall be stricken with darkness and shorn of grace and all the foremost of the Rākşasas shall be destroyed.

sa: स गान्धर्वेण गान्धर्वं दैवं दैवेन राघवः। अस्त्रं राक्षसराजस्य जघान परमास्त्रवित्॥
en: Rāghava highly proficient in weapons with a Gândharva weapon resisted the Gandharva weapons of the Rākşasa king and with a celestial weapon, his celestial weapon.

sa: बाणाभिहतमर्मत्वान्न शक्नोषीह भाषितुम्। रुजा चाब्रुवतो यस्य दृष्टिरागेण सूच्यते॥
en: In consequence of shafts piercing your vitals, you cannot speak; but your visible expression, albeit you are dumb, betokens pain.

sa: प्रहरन्तं शरीरेषु न ते पश्यन्ति राघवम्। इन्द्रियार्थेषु तिष्ठन्तं भूतात्मानामिव प्रजाः॥
en: As people cannot see the soul which governs all objects of sense so they could not see Rāma, who was thus inflicting wounds on them.

sa: रावणश्च मया दृष्टो मुण्डस्तैलसमुक्षितः॥ रक्तवासा पिबन्मत्तः करवीरकृतस्रजः। विमानात् पुष्पकादद्य रावणः पतितः क्षितौ॥
en: I saw Ravana too, shaved and shorn, besmeared with oil, wearing a crimson cloth, drinking honey, wearing a garland of Karavīra flowers, fall down on earth from the flowery chariot.

sa: अहो बलमहो वीर्यमहो गाम्भीर्यमेव च। येनाहं पशुवगृह्य भ्रामितश्चतुरोऽर्णवान्॥
en: What strength is your! what prowess! What gravity! Holding me like a beast you have journeyed over the four oceans.

sa: कुम्भकर्णादयश्चेमे सर्वे राक्षसपुङ्गवाः। रक्तं निवसनं गृह्य प्रविष्टा गोमयहृदम्॥
en: I saw all the leading Raksasas-Kumbhakarņā and others, dark-hued and wearing crimson clothes, emerged in an abyss of cow dung.

sa: विस्मयं तु महद्गत्वा श्रमलोलनिरीक्षणः। राक्षसेन्द्रो हरीन्द्रं तमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon being surprised greatly, Daśānana, the king of Rākşasas, with eyes, shaking with exhaustion, said to the king of monkeys.

sa: भविष्यत्येवमेतत्ते वचो राक्षसपुङ्गव । एवमुक्त्वा तु तं गम दशग्रीवं पितामहः॥
en: O foremost of Rākşasas, what you say shall come to pass. Having O Rāma, said this to the Ten-necked one, the Great-father (again spoke), Hear!

sa: श्रुत्वा तु परमानन्दं भरतः सत्यविक्रमः। हृष्टमाज्ञापयामास शत्रुघ्नं परवीरहा॥
en: Hearing those words affording great delight, Bharata, the slayer of enemies, having truth for his prowess, delighted, ordered Satrughna, (saying).

sa: घोरं प्रकृत्या रूपं तत्तस्य क्रोधाग्निमूर्च्छितम्। बभूव रूपं क्रुद्धस्य रुद्रस्येव व्यवस्थितम्॥
en: And his form, terrific by nature, in consequence of the fire of his wrath having possessed it entirely, resembled the form of the enraged Rudra.

sa: अदृश्यमानेन रणे भायया वासवोपमौ। मम नाथावनाथाया निहतौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: Through illusion have those lords of me, who am forlorn. Rāma and Lakşmaņa, resembling Vasava himself in battle, been slain.

sa: रक्षिता स्वस्य वृत्तस्य स्वजनस्यापि रक्षिता। रक्षिता जीवलोकस्य धर्मस्य च परंतपः॥
en: He was the protector of his own character, of his own kinsmen, of the whole world of creation and of virtue and subduer of foes.

sa: या या मे जायते बुद्धिर्येषु येष्वाश्रमेषु च॥ सा सा भवतु धर्मिष्ठा तं तं धर्म च पालये। एष मे परमोदार वरः परमको मतः॥ नहि धर्माभिरक्तानां लोके किंचन दुर्लभम्। पुनः प्रजापतिः प्रीतो विभीषणमुवाच ह॥
en: And inay every sense of mine sprung during the observance of particular modes of life, be in unison with righteousness, so that I may practice the form of religion (in harmony with any particular mode of life !) O exceedingly noble one, this best of boons, is even what is sought for by me, for nothing in this world is incapable of being attained by those attached to righteousness.' Then the lord of creatures, being again delighted, spoke to Vibhīşaņa.

sa: अर्जुनेन विमुक्तस्तु रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। चचार पृथिवीं सर्वानिर्विण्णस्तथा कृतः॥
en: Released by Arjuna, and yet not conceiving any shame, Rāvana, the king of Räkşasas again began to transverse the earth.

sa: एवं हि ते भवेत् स्वस्ति सम्प्रदाय रघूत्तमे। अन्यथा त्वं हि कुर्वाणः परां प्राप्स्यसि चापदम्॥
en: You shall meet with your well-being if do you in this wise confer me on that best of Raghus. And mighty is the disaster that shall befall you, if do you follow any other procedure.

sa: इन्द्रजित्तु महामायः सर्वसैन्यसमावृतः। विवेश नगरी लङ्कां पितरं चाभ्युपागमत्॥
en: And Indrajit, worker of mighty illusionsaccompanied by his troops, entered the city of Larkā and presented himself before his father.

sa: ततो विमानाग्रगतं भरतो भ्रातरं तदा। ववन्दे प्रणतो रामं मेरुस्थमिव भास्करम्॥
en: Thereupon Bharata humbly saluted his brother Rāma seated on the top of the car like to the Sun on the summit (of the mount Meru).

sa: रथप्रवरमास्थाय खरयुक्तं खरस्वनम्। प्रयान्तं तु महाघोरं राक्षसं भीमदर्शनम्॥ अन्तरिक्षगताः क्रूराः शकुनाः प्रत्यषेधयन्।
en: Thereat, fell fowls of the air forbade that exceedingly dreadful Räksasa of a fearful form, as he went out ascending an excellent car joked with mules, and sending sharp sounds.

sa: विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वचारणा दानवैः सह॥ राममार्तं तदा दृष्ट्वा सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। व्यथिता वानरेन्द्राश्च बभूवुः सविभीषणाः॥
en: Seeing Rāma hard pressed, celestials and Gandharvas and Carañas along with Dänavas, and Sidhas, and the supreme saints were overcome with sadness; and the foremost monkeys together with Vibhīşaņa aggrieved.

sa: आपृच्छामो गमिष्यामो हृदिस्थो नः सदा भवान्। वर्तामहे महाबाहो प्रीत्यात्र महता वृताः॥ भवेच्च ते महाराज प्रीतिरस्मासु नित्यदा। बाढमित्येव राजानो हर्षेण परमान्विताः॥
en: With your permission we shall now leave for our respective provinces but you shall always reside in our hearts. O you having long arms, O great king, may you have that love for us perpetually that we may find place in your heart. Whereto Rama replied saying "so be it."

sa: स समुत्थाय पतितः कपिस्तस्य व्यसर्जयत्॥ तलप्रहारमशनेः समानं भीमनि:स्वनम्।
en: The monkey rising up again was about to deal him a blow, hard as a thunder-bolt, with a dreadful sound.

sa: आदिष्टा वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण महौजसः। अद्रिराजप्रतीकाशाः सर्वतः प्रस्थिता महीम्॥
en: The highly powerful monkeys, resembling mountains, commanded by that lord of monkeys, proceeded to all the regions of the earth.

sa: तयोस्तु धनुषी श्रेष्ठे बाहुभिः परिघोपमैः। विकृष्यमाणे बलवत्क्रौञ्चाविव चुकूजतुः॥
en: On their best of bows being powerfully drawn with their arms resembling bludgeons, they set up cries like to Krauñcas.

sa: आज्ञापय यथातत्त्वं वक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन। तत्करिष्याम्यहं वीर गतानृण्येन चेतसा ॥
en: Command me. What you say, O destroyer of foes. I will do every way, O hero with my whole soul.

sa: ततः संसक्तहस्तस्तु रावणो लोकरावणः। नाराचमालां रामस्य ललाटे प्रत्यमुश्चत॥
en: Then that destroyer of creatures-Ravana, with his hand engaged in discharging shafts, shot at Rāma's forehead a network of arrows.

sa: चारु तद् वदनं तस्यास्ताम्रशुक्लायतेक्षणम्। अशोभत विशालाक्ष्या राहुमुक्त इवोडुराट्॥
en: The beautiful countenance of that large-eyed dame, having spacious eyes, appeared like the Moon released from the hold of Rāhu.

sa: तौ तु क्रूरेण निहतौ रक्षसा कामरूपिणा। असृक्सुनुवतुस्तीवं जलं प्रस्रवणाविव ॥
en: They being wounded by that fell one capable of assuming shapes at will, blood violently gushed out of their bodies like water from a spring.

sa: सधूमपरिवृत्तोर्मिः प्रज्वलनिव सागरः॥ उत्पपात तदा क्रुद्धः स्पृशनिव दिवाकरम्।
en: The enraged Ocean, heaving with smoking surges and flaming as it were swelled up seeming to the touch the Sun.

sa: शयनेषु महार्हेषु शयित्वा राक्षसेश्वर॥ इह कस्मात्प्रसुप्तोऽसि धरण्यां रेणुगुण्ठितः।
en: O lord of Raksasas, used are to many a valuable bed, why are you sleeping on earth covered with dust?

sa: सकृदेव कृतो रावः सरक्तपृषतो घनैः। महोदरमहापार्श्वधूम्राक्षशुकसारणैः॥ संवृतो राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु तत्रागाद्यत्र चार्जुनः।
en: The clouds began to mutter with a downpour of rain. And the lord of Räkşasas proceeded against Arjuna with Mahodara. Mahāparáva, Dhumraksa, Suka and Sarana.

sa: स प्रहस्य महातेजा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। अभिदुद्राव तद्रक्षः कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्॥
en: And laughing, that exceedingly energetic offspring of the Wind-god rushed after that Rākşasa, as if making the Earth herself tremble.

sa: श्रुताश्च दृष्ट्वा हि मया पराक्रमा महात्मनस्तस्य रणावमर्दिनः। न देवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गराक्षसा भवन्ति रामेण समा हि संयुगे॥
en: I have heard of and myself seen the prowess of the highly-souled (Rāma) unconquerable in a battle. There is none among the celestials, Gandharvas, Nāgas and the Rākşasas who can match him in a conflict.

sa: समीक्ष्य तं संयति चित्रकार्मुकं महाबलं वासवतुल्यविक्रमम्। सलक्ष्मणं को विषहेत राघवं हुताशनं दीप्तमिवानिलेरितम्॥
en: Beholding that highly powerful Rāghava, in a conflict, like to Vāsava in prowess, holding a wonderful bow and followed by Lakşmaņa, who can withstand his prowess resembling the flaming fire?

sa: अकम्पनस्तु तदृष्ट्वा गिरिशृङ्ग समुद्यतम्। दूरादेव महाबाणैरर्धचन्द्रैरदारयत्॥
en: Akampana, seeing that uplifted crag, from a distance cut it off with mighty crescent-shaped shafts.

sa: दुःखार्ता रुदती सीता वेपमाना तपस्विनी। चिन्तयन्ती वरारोहा पतिमेव पतिव्रता ॥
en: Racked with grief, engaged in asceticism and weeping, Sita began. to tremble. And that excellent damsel, devoted to her husband, began to think of him.

sa: स कुरुष्व महोत्साहां कृपां मयि नरर्षभ। त्वया नाथवती नाथ अनाथा इव दृश्यते॥
en: O foremost of men, do you dispense to me your kindness capable of inspiring hope. O lord, possessing a lord in you, I (now) appear as if I had none.

sa: ते शराः शिखिसंस्पर्शा निपतन्तः समाहिताः। राक्षसान्दारयामासुर्वज्रा इव महागिरीन्॥
en: Even like thunder-bolt cleaving mighty mountains, those shafts furnished with peacock's plumes falling powerfully (upon the foe), rent the Raksasas.

sa: विरराज महावीर्यो महाकायो महाबलः। पुष्पिताशोकसंकाशो विधूम इव पावकः॥
en: That huge-bodied one endowed with wondrous prowess and great strength, appeared like a flowering Asoka or a fie without smoke.

sa: तेषां रामः शरैः षड्भिः षड् जघान निशाचरान्। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः॥ यज्ञशत्रुश्च दुर्धर्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ। वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाकायस्तौ चोभौ शुकसारणौ॥
en: In the twinkling of an eye, Räma by means of six shafts resembling tongues of flames, struck six of the night-rangers, viz., Yajñaśatru, irrepressible (in fight), and Mahaparsva, and Mahodara, and the huge bodied Vajradanstra, and those two-Suka and Sarana.

sa: इयं वापि सरिच्छेष्टा नर्मदा शर्मवर्धिनी। नक्रमीनविहंगोर्मिः सभयेवाङ्गना स्थिता॥
en: This charming Narmadā, abounding in crocodiles, fishes and birds, though a natural stream, is standing still like a terrified damsel.

sa: वालुकावेदिमध्ये तु तल्लिङ्गं स्थाप्य रावणः। अर्चयामास गन्धैश्च पुष्पैश्चामृतगन्धिभिः॥
en: Thereupon Rāvaņa placed that upon a heap of sands and began to worship it with various nectar-smelling flowers and sandal.

sa: अतिभक्तं त्वया सार्धं राज्यं यच्चापि मे वसु। एवमुक्त्वा धनाध्यक्षो जगाम पितुरन्तिकम्॥ अभिवाद्य गुरुं प्राह रावणस्य यदीप्सितम्। एष तात दशग्रीवो दूतं प्रेषितवान्मम॥ दीयतां नगरी लङ्का पूर्वं रक्षोगणोषिता। मयात्र यदनुष्ठेयं तन्ममाचक्ष्व सुव्रत॥
en: May my kingdom and wealth never undergo division when you are present! 'Having said this, the lord of riches sought the side of his sire, and, paying him reverence, he communicated Ravana's wish to him:' My father, this Tennecked one had sent a messenger to me, saying, Give (back) the city Lankā, which had before been inhabited by hosts of Rakşasa. Now, O you of excellent vows, do you tell me what I should do.

sa: तदत्रं राघवः श्रीमानुत्तमास्त्रविदां वरः। जघान परमात्रेण गान्धर्वेण महाद्युतिः॥
en: Thereupon the graceful and exceedingly effulgent Rāghava-foremost of those accomplished in noble arms-resisted that weapon with a powerful Gandharva weapon.

sa: निष्पतन्ति ततः सैन्या हृष्टा रावणचोदिताः। समये पूर्यमाणस्य वेगा इव महोदधेः॥
en: And commanded by Råvana, the troops cheerfully issued forth like the onrushing of the mighty main filling all at the time of the universal dissolution.

sa: बहवो राक्षसा युद्धे बहून्वानरपुंगवान्। वानरा राक्षसांश्चापि निजघ्नुर्बहवो बहून्॥
en: And many Rākşasas in conflict slew many a powerful monkey, and the monkeys on their part slaughtered many a Rākşasa.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तदा वाक्यं रावणस्य मुखेरितम्। सहसा भीमनिर्घोषमुद्धष्टं रजनीचरैः॥
en: Hearing those words, which came out from Ravana's mouth, all of a sudden the nightrangers sent up a dreadful yell.

sa: विचचाराम्बरे वीरः परिगृह्य च मारुतिः। सूदयामास वज्रेण दैत्यानिव सहस्रदृक् ॥
en: And grasping (the bolt), the Wind-god' son began to range the welkin and destroy (the Rākşasas) like the thousand-eyed (deity) slaughtering Daityas with his thunder-bold.

sa: ब्रह्मर्षिस्त्वेवमुक्तोऽसौ विश्रवा मुनिपुंगवः। प्राञ्जलिं धनदं प्राह शृणु पुत्र वचो मम॥
en: Thus accosted, that foremost of ascetics, the Brahmarși Viśravă spoke to the lord of riches (standing) with joined hands, 'O son, listen to my words.

sa: उत्तरद्वारमागम्य रामः सौमित्रिणा सह। आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ सुग्रीवश्च हरीश्वरः॥
en: Obstructing the Northern gate, remained the puissant Răma himself along with Sumitrā's son, as well as the king of monkeys-Sugriva.

sa: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा रावणिः क्रोधमूर्छितः। अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं क्रोधेनाभ्युत्पपात च॥
en: Hearing Vibhisana's words, the son of Ravana, deprived of his senses by passion, spoke harshly, and rushed forward in wrath.

sa: खराश्च खरनिर्घोषा गगने परुषा घनाः। औत्पातिकाश्च नर्दन्तः समन्तात्परिचक्रमुः॥
en: And rough and terrific clouds in the sky sent forth fierce roars. And stormy clouds rumbling went about the heavens.

sa: जयत्युरुबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः॥ इत्येवं घोषयन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवंगमाः। अभ्यधावन्त लङ्कायाः प्राकारं कामरूपिणः॥
en: Victory to the mighty Rāma, and victory to the exceedingly powerful Lakşmaņa, and Victory to king Sugriva, who is protected by Rāghava.' Thus shouting, those monkeys, wearing forms at will, sending up roars, rushed amain towards the wall of Lankā.

sa: काञ्चनानि प्रमर्दन्तस्तोरणानि प्लवंगमाः। कैलासशिखराग्राणि गोपुराणि प्रमथ्य च॥ आप्लवन्तः प्लवन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवंगमाः। लङ्कां तामभिधावन्ति महावारणसंनिभाः॥
en: The monkeys crushed golden gateways; and, breaking down gates resembling the tops of the summits of Kailasa, bounded roaring, some towards the wall and some all around. And resembling gigantic elephants, they rushed towards Lankā.

sa: जग्राह भरतो रश्मीशत्रुघ्नश्छत्रमाददे। लक्ष्मणो व्यजनं तस्य मूर्ध्नि संवीजयंस्तदा॥
en: Bharata took up the reins, ſatrughna held the umbrella and Lakşmaņa began to fan him on the head with Chowries.

sa: नह्यहं तं कपिं मन्ये कर्मणा प्रतितर्कयन्। सर्वथा तन्महद् भूतं महाबलपरिग्रहम्॥
en: Having regard to his acts, I do not take him to be a monkey. He is a great being endowed with extraordinary prowess every way.

sa: ग्राहयामास तारेयः स्वयमात्मानमात्मवान्। बलं दर्शयितुं वीरो यातुधानगणे तदा॥
en: Tara's son suffered himself to be taken, in order that the hero might then display his prowess before the Yātudhānas.

sa: इहोपहारं भूतानां बलवान्रावणात्मजः। उपहृत्य ततः पश्चात्संग्राममभिवर्तते।४॥
en: Here offering presents to the ghosts, the powerful son of Răvaņa afterwards engages in conflict.

sa: इत्युक्तः स तु तारेयो रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। जगामाकाशमाविश्य मूर्तिमानिव हव्यवाट्॥
en: Thus addressed by Rāma of untiring deeds, Tara's son went through the welkin like the embodied bearer of sacrificial offerings.

sa: ज्ञायतां तूर्णमेतेषां सर्वेषां च वनौकसाम्। शोककाले समुत्पन्ने हर्षकारणमुत्थितम्॥
en: Do you speedily acquaint yourselves with the cause of rejoicing that has arisen of these monkeys on this mournful occasion.

sa: भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चात्र शत्रुघ्नश्च महायशाः। उपासांचक्रिरे हृष्टा वेदास्त्रय इवाध्वरम्॥
en: The illustrious Bharata, Laksmana and Śatrughna began to worship him and he appeared like a sacrifice conducted by Vedic hymns.

sa: शराणामग्रतस्तस्य पुनः समभिवर्तत। प्रसार्य हस्तौ हनुमानुत्पपातानिलात्मजः॥
en: And again facing the arrows and stretching his hands, the Wind-god's son again leaped up.

sa: बलवान्दुर्जयश्चैव भविष्यत्येव राक्षसः। यं समाश्रित्य ते राजहन्स्थापितास्त्रिदशा वशे॥
en: The Raksasa shall be powerful and irrepressible, by those help, O King, the celestials have been brought under your subjection.

sa: ततो धैर्यमवष्टभ्य रामः परपुरंजयः। विभीषणमुपासीनमुवाच कपिसंनिधौ॥
en: Then, summoning up patience, Rāma-captor of hostile capitals, spoke to Vibhisana, seated near the monkeys.

sa: ते सर्वे रामदचानि रत्नानि कपिराक्षसाः। शिरोभिर्धारयामासुर्भुजेषु च महाबलाः॥
en: And those highly powerful monkeys and night-rangers wore on their heads and arms those jewels conferred on them by Rāma.

sa: रारुह्य घण्टानिनदप्रणादम्। गजं खरं गर्जति वै महात्मा महोदरो नाम स एष वीरः॥
en: That high souled hero is named Mahodara that, furnished with right coppery eyes resembling the sun new risen, and ascending a car resonant with the sound of bells, shout shrill.

sa: काचिद् वीणां परिष्वज्य प्रसुप्ता सम्प्रकाशते। महानदीप्रकीर्णेव नलिनी पोतमाश्रिता॥
en: Another was seen asleep, embracing a Vīņā, like a lotus with spreading petals, resting by the side of a raft.

sa: यदिदं लोकविद्विष्टमुदाहरत संगताः। नैतन्मनसि वाक्यं मे किल्विषं प्रतितिष्ठति॥
en: What you have all said and which is against human usage and vicious, dose not find place in my mind.

sa: त इमे कृतकर्माणः सर्व एव वनौकसः। धनरत्नप्रदानैश्च कर्मैषां सफलं कुरु॥
en: Do you, with a gift of riches and jewel, make good the work of these monkeys and bears who encompassed the accomplishment (of my end).

sa: ततो रथं समास्थाय रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। तत्सैन्यमतिसंक्रुद्धः प्रविवेश सुदारुणम्॥
en: Thereupon ascending his car Ravana's son, became senseless by his wrath and beside himself with rage, entered the dreadful flank.

sa: असंशयं शत्रुरयं प्रवृद्धः कृतं ह्यनेनाप्रियमप्रमेयम्। न दूतवध्यां प्रवदन्ति सन्तो दूतस्य दृष्टा बहवो हि दण्डाः॥
en: Surely this is an overgrown enemy; and he has perpetrated immense injury (to us). But say the good, envoys are not to be slain, albeit many are the punishments that have been assigned for messengers.

sa: नीलमेघनिभांश्चास्य सदश्वान्पर्वतोपमान्। जघानाप्लुत्य गदया रावणस्य विभीषणः॥
en: Vibhīşaņa, bounding up, with his mace despatched Ravana's excellent steeds, resembling hills or dark-blue clouds.

sa: ग्रसमान इवाकाशं ताराधिपमिवोल्लिखन्। हरनिव सनक्षत्रं गगनं सार्कमण्डलम्॥ अपारमपरिश्रान्तश्चाम्बुधिं समगाहत। हनूमान् मेघजालानि विकर्षन्निव गच्छति ॥
en: As if swallowing up the welkin and touching the lord of stars, abolishing the sky decorated with stars and the solar disc, and cleaving the clouds, the unfatigued Hanuman began to cross over that sea.

sa: स तं देशमनुप्राप्तः सुहृद्दर्शनलालसः॥ ननाद सुमहानादं लाङ्गूलं चाप्यकम्पयत्।
en: And arriving at that place, he, eager to behold his friends, emitted tremendous roars, and began to flourish his tail.

sa: जाम्बवान्स हरिश्रेष्ठः प्रीतिसंहृष्टमानसः। उपामन्त्र्य हरिन्सर्वानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: And that best of monkeys, Jambavan, with a joyful heart addressing all the monkeys, said.

sa: विषसाद च हस्तेन गृहीत्वा वालिनः सुतम्। रमणीये वनोद्देशे महेन्द्रस्य गिरेस्तदा॥ हनूमानब्रवीत्पृष्टस्तदा तान्वानरर्षभान्। अशोकवनिकासंस्था दृष्टा सा जनकात्मजा॥
en: Taking Vāli's son by the hand, he sat him down in a charming tract of the woodland belonging to the mountain Mahendra. Then asked (by them), Hanumān addressed those foremost monkeys, "I have seen Janaka's daughter in the Asoka woods."

sa: स रामः कृत्यसिद्ध्यर्थमेवमुक्त्वा बिभीषणम्। सुवेलारोहणे बुद्धिं चकार मतिमान्प्रभुः।। रमणीयतरं दृष्ट्वा सुवेलस्य गिरेस्तटम्॥
en: Having said this to Vibhísaņa for attaining success in the enterprise, that lord, the intelligent Rāma, seeing the sides of Suvela more beautiful (than other places), intended to ascend it.

sa: दृष्ट्वा पथि हनूमांश्च तदृक्षबलमुद्यतम्। नीलमेघनिभं भीमं संनिवार्य न्यवर्तत॥
en: Seeing on the way that host of bears dreadful and resembling dark clouds, on the march, Hanumān made them desist.

sa: सा तस्योपरि चोल्काभा पतन्ती विवभौ गदा। इन्द्रप्रमुक्ता गर्जन्ती गिराविव महाशनिः॥
en: Having fallen on his head that mace shone like a fire-brand as the thunderbolt discharged by Indra, falls roaring on the summit of a mountain.

sa: यश्चार्थस्तत्र वक्तव्यो गतैरस्माभिरात्मवान्। रक्षितव्यं च यत्तत्र तद् भवान् व्याकरोतु नः॥
en: And do you also tell us what we, repairing there, shall unfold to that one of controlled self and what we shall keep to ourselves.

sa: तद्भवांश्चतुरङ्गेण बलेन महता वृतम्। व्यूह्येदं वानरानीकं निर्मथिष्यसि रावणम्॥
en: Therefore you, environed by a mighty army, having arrayed the monkey-forces in order of battle, shall thrash Ravana (in battle)

sa: तमिन्द्रजितमप्राप्यरथस्थं सहसारथिम्। विवेश धरणी भित्वा सा शिला व्यर्थमुद्यता॥
en: And not reaching Indrajit stationed on the car and the charioteer, that crag, uselessly hurled, fell down on the earth.

sa: ते प्रबुद्धा महावीर्या अयोन्यमभिवीक्ष्य वै। संग्राममेवाभिमुखा अभ्यवर्तन्त हृष्टवत्॥
en: Having got up and cast their looks upon one another the highly powerful Rākşasas waited there for the battle, delighted.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नादः शुश्राव रजनीक्षये। तस्य रावणसैन्यस्य प्रयुद्धस्य समन्ततः॥
en: Meanwhile at the latter part of the night there was audible the uproar of Rāvana's army fighting on all sides.

sa: भूत्वा शकुनयः सर्वे प्रविष्टाश्च रिपोर्बलम्। विधानं विहितं यच्च तदृष्ट्वा समुपस्थिताः॥
en: Wearing the forms of birds, they entered into the hostile forces; and, having seen the measures that had been adopted (by them, have come (back).

sa: ततो द्विविदमैन्दाभ्यां नीलाय च परंतपः। सर्वान्कामगुणान्वीक्ष्य प्रददौ वसुधाधिपः॥
en: Thereupon, the lord of earth and the slayer of foes conferred, all wished for things, upon Dvivida, Mainda and Nila.

sa: सुग्रीवो वानरश्रेष्ठो दृष्ट्वा रामाभिषेचनम्। पूजितश्चैव रामेण किष्किन्धां प्राविशत्पुरीम्॥
en: And beholding the inauguration of Răma, Sugrīva, the foremost of monkeys, honoured by Rāma, repaired to the city of Kiskindhā.

sa: तदाचक्ष्व यथा तत्त्वं देवदेव मम स्वयम्। असिचक्रसहायस्त्वं योत्स्यसे रावणं प्रति॥
en: Do you tell me, the truth, O god of gods, that I may myself fight; or do you, with your sword and discus, vanquish Ravana.

sa: विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे राक्षसा दीनचेतसः। विद्रवन्ति ततः सर्वे भयवित्रस्तचेतसः॥
en: All the Räksasas with their hearts broken and countenances rendered poorly and stricken with fear fled away to different quarters.

sa: स एवमुक्तः कुपितः ससर्ज रक्षोधिपः सप्त शरान्सुपुङ्खान्।। ताल्लक्ष्मणः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खैश्चिच्छेद् बाणैर्निशिताग्रधारैः॥
en: Thus accosted, the Raksasa monarch, growing wroth, discharged seven shafts furnished with knobs. Thereupon Lakşmaņa split them up with sharp-pointed arrows having variegated golden knobs.

sa: पौलस्त्यस्य वरिष्ठस्य रावणस्य महात्मनः। दशग्रीवस्य भार्यात्वं सीते न बहु मन्यसे॥
en: You do not regard it highly, Sītā, that you shall become the chosen wife of that highsouled, and great Ravana, the Ten-necked son of Paulastya.

sa: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना चैत्यप्रासादमुत्तमम्। तत्रस्थान् राक्षसान् हत्वा शतं स्तम्भेन वै पुनः॥ ललामभूतो लङ्काया मया विध्वंसितो रुषा।
en: Thereupon I thought of destroying the Caitya (A place of sacrifice or religious worship) palace and destroyed with the pillar, all the Rākşasas stationed there. Excited with wrath I destroyed that palace the best in the whole city of Lanka.

sa: स तु वैहायसरथो युधि तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। अचक्षुर्विषये तिष्ठन्विव्याध निशितैः शरैः॥
en: He was seated in a car in the welkin and hidden from the human gaze and began to assail! Ráma and Lakşmaņa with sharp shafts.

sa: स तां सधूमानलसंनिकाशा वित्रासनां संयति वानराणाम्। चिक्षेप शक्तिं तरसा ज्वलन्ती सौमित्रये राक्षसराष्ट्रनाथः॥
en: The sovereign of the Rākşasas and their lord in that encounter hurled at Sumitrā's son the dart resembling smoking fire, sending up living flames, and striking terror into the monkeys.

sa: समागम्य महावेगः संन्यस्य शिखरं गिरेः। विश्रम्य किंचिद्धनुमान्सुषेणमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
en: Arriving (at his quarters) that wondrous vehement one putting down the mountain-peak, and reposing for a while, spoke to Susena.

sa: विसृज्य शिबिकां तस्मात्पद्व्यामेवापसर्पतु। समीपे मम वैदेहीं पश्यन्त्वेते वनौकसः॥
en: Therefore leaving behind the palanquin let her come here on foot and let the monkeys behold Vaidehī in my presence.

sa: निपातितमहावीरां वानराणां महाचमूम्। राघवस्तु रणे दृष्ट्वा रावणं समभिद्रवत्॥
en: Witnessing the mighty army of the monkeys and the redoubted heroes brought down in the conflict, Rāghava rushed at Ravana.

sa: संनाहजननी ह्येषा भैरवा भीरु भेरिका। भेरीनादं च गम्भीरं शृणु तोयदनिःस्वनम्॥
en: These dreadful sounds of the kettledrum, O mother, call to arms. And hark to the solemn notes of the kettledrums, resembling the rumbling of clouds!

sa: तस्य चैकतमे देशे दिव्यमालोपशोभितम्। ददर्श पाण्डुरं छत्रं ताराधिपतिसंनिभम्॥
en: At one place thereof he saw a white umbrella, adorned with beautiful wreaths, resembling the lord of the stars himself.

sa: मयैव निहता लङ्का दग्धा भस्मीकृता पुरी। राजमार्गेषु सर्वेषु नाम विश्रावितं मया॥ जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः॥ अहं कोसलराजस्य दासः पवनसम्भवः। हनूमानिति सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया॥
en: By me along has the city Lankā been devastated burnt down and reduced to ashes. And I had announced in the public streets there—“May victory crown the highly powerful Ram and Lakşmaņa, and may the king Sugrīva advance in prosperity being protected by Rāghava. I am the servant of the king of Kosala, the own begotten son of the Wind-God and my name is Hanumān. I have announced thus everywhere.”

sa: मोहितां राक्षसेन्द्रेण सीतां परमदुःखिताम्। आश्वासयामास तदा सरमा मृदुभाषिणी॥
en: The mild-speeched Saramă comforted the exceedingly distressed Sītā, who had been bereft of her senses by the lord of Rākşasas.

sa: ताभ्यां स परिपूर्णाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां राक्षसेश्वरः। शुशुभेऽचलसंकाशः शृङ्गाभ्यामिव मन्दरः॥
en: With his two plump arms, ihat lord of Rākşasas appeared like to the hill Mandara with its two huge summits.

sa: वारिताराक्षसान्दृष्ट्वा मकराक्षो निशाचरः। कोपानलसमाविष्टो वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Beholding the Rākşasas thus overpowered, the night-ranger Makarākşa, excited with the flame of ire, said.

sa: तमिमं मानुषं मन्ये रामं दशरथात्मजम्। इक्ष्वाकुकुलजातेन अनरण्येन यत्पुरा॥ उत्पत्स्यति हि मद्वंशपुरुषो राक्षसाधम। यस्त्वां सपुत्रं सामात्यं सबलं साश्वसारथिम्।९।। निहनिष्यति संग्रामे त्वां कुलाधम दुर्मते।
en: I deem even this son of Dasaratha as the occasion of my fear. I was formerly cursed by that lord of the Ikşawaku line-Anaranya-saying, 'O worst of Rākşasas, a person shall spring in my race, who, O wicked-minded one, shall you in battle along with your sons and courtiers and forces and horses and charioteers.

sa: अक्षोहिणीसहस्राणि चत्वार्यग्र्याणि रक्षसाम्।।३३ नानाप्रहरणान्याशु निर्ययुयुद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम्। इन्द्रजित्त्वग्रतः सैन्यात्सैनिकान्परिगृह्य च॥ जगाम रावणो मध्ये कुम्भकर्णश्च पृष्ठतः। विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा लङ्कायां धर्ममाचरन्॥ शेषाः सर्वे महाभागा ययुर्मधुपुरं प्रति।
en: Thereupon issued out for battle leading Rākşasas four thousand Akşauhiņi strong taking various weapons. Commanding them Indrajit proceeded the army, Răvaņa went in the middle and Kumbhakarna was in the rear; the virtuoussouled Vibhīşaņa remained in Lankā, being engaged in pious observances. And the rest of the leading Rākşasas proceeded towards the city of Madhu.

sa: शिष्टमत्रापविध्यन्ति भक्षयन्ति तथापरे। निवार्यमाणास्ते सर्वे भ्रुकुटिं दर्शयन्ति हि।।।।।
en: Some of them went beyond the pale of food conduct, others ate at their pleasure, and all frowned (at us).

sa: तान्यनीकान्यनेकानि रावणस्य शरोत्तमैः। दृष्ट्वा भग्नानि शतशो राघवः पर्यवस्थितः॥
en: Beholding his own army, assailed and cut into hundred pieces by the excellent weapons of Rāvana Råghava dashed forward. a

sa: सा हृता मधुना राजनराक्षसेन बलीयसा। यज्ञप्रवृत्ते पुत्रे तु मयि चान्तर्जलोषिते॥ कुम्भकर्णो महाराज निद्रामनुभवत्यथ। निहत्य राक्षसश्रेष्ठानमात्यानिह संमतान्॥ धर्षयित्वा हृता राजनगुप्ताप्यन्तःपुरे तव।
en: Your son being engaged in the sacrifice and myself being under waters she was stolen away, Oking, by the powerful Rākşasa Madhu. Kumbhakarma, ogreat king, was then asleep. Having slain all the powerful Rākşasas and your councillors, he had stolen her away, O king, who was in your inner apartments.

sa: दुमवर्षं तु तद्भिन्नं दृष्ट्वा कुम्भेन वीर्यवान्॥ वानराधिपतिः श्रीमान्महासत्त्वो न विव्यथे।
en: Seeing that shower of trees riven by Kumbha, the graceful lord of the monkeys endowed with exceeding strength and prowess, did not feel any mortification.

sa: तस्य बाणपथं प्राप्य न शेकुरपि वीक्षितुम्। वानरेन्द्रा महात्मानो वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: Even the great deep cannot see his own shores, those high-souled lord of monkeys, coming within the range of his arrows, could not even see.

sa: एवं परुषमुक्तस्तु हितबुद्धिरबुद्धिना। अब्रवीद्रावणं सूतो हितं सानुनयं वचः॥
en: Thus admonished by him of slender sense, the charioteer possessed of intelligence, humbly spoke to Råvaņa words fraught with good.

sa: पुरा कृतयुगे राम प्रजापतिसुतः प्रभुः। पुलस्त्यो नाम ब्रह्मर्षिः साक्षादिव पितामहः॥
en: Formerly in the Krita age, O Rama, there was a Brahmarsi-lord (of creatures), son to Prajapati, and like to the very self of the great-father.

sa: शङ्खांश्च पूरयामासुः शशाङ्कसदृशप्रभान्। तुमुलं युगपच्चापि विनेदुश्चाप्यमर्षिताः॥
en: They winded conchs beaming moon-like. And they incapable of being beaten shouted in full chorus.

sa: अस्मिंस्तु शिखरे जातामोषधीं तां सुखावहाम्। प्रतर्केणावगच्छामि सुषेणो ह्येवमब्रवीत्॥
en: In this very summit must that delightful drug have sprung. This I inter, inasmuch as Susena had forsooth said so.

sa: द्विविदः शोणिताक्षं तु विददार नखैर्मुखे। निष्पिपेष स वीर्येण क्षितावाविध्य वीर्यवान्॥
en: And Dvivida with his nail tore ſoņitākşa's face; and that powerful one violently bringing him down to the earth, pressed him with might and main.

sa: दैवतानि न नन्दन्ति धर्मयुक्तन केन चित्। येन त्वमीदृशं भावं नीतस्तच्च न बुद्ध्यसे॥
en: The gods have set their face against you on account of a certain misdeed of your; and having for this, been reduced to this condition, you do not understand things.

sa: उद्यम्य विपुलं खङ्गं परमर्मविदारणम्। प्रजबो वालिपुत्राय अभिदुद्राव वेगितः॥
en: And summoning speed, Prajangha darted against Väli's son, upraising a huge scimitar capable of piercing into the vitals of trees.

sa: अभिज्ञानं च मे दत्तं यथावृतं तवान्तिके। चित्रकूटे महाप्राज्ञ वायसं प्रति राघव ॥
en: O you of great intelligence, O Raghava, offering me (this jewel) as a token, she wanted me to relate to you, the occurrence at the mount Citrakūța regarding the crow.

sa: उपयातं च मां सौम्य भरताय निवेदय। सह राक्षसराजेन हरीणामीश्वरेण च ॥ जित्वा शत्रुगणारामः प्राप्य चानुत्तमं यशः। उपायाति समृद्धार्थः सह मित्रैर्महाबलैः॥
en: Do you, O gentle one, communicate to Bharata, my arrival here with the lord of Räks and king of monkeys. (Tell him) ‘vanquishing his foes and attaining to excellent fame Rāma has arrived at the gate of the city with his valiant friends, having satisfied the vow (of his sire).

sa: किमाह सीता वैदेही ब्रूहि सौम्य पुनः पुनः। परासुमिव तोयेन सिञ्चन्ती वाक्यवारिणा ॥
en: Do you relate to me again and again, O gentle one what Vaidehi has said, as if sprinkling me with the water of her words like to one rendered senseless.

sa: तां रत्नवसनोपेतां गोष्ठागारवतंसिकाम्। यन्त्रागारस्तनीमृद्धां प्रमदामिव भूषिताम्॥ तां नष्टतिमिरां दीपै स्वरैश्च महाग्रहै:। नगरी राक्षसेन्द्रस्य स ददर्श महाकपिः॥ अथ सा हरिशार्दूलं प्रविशन्तं महाकपिम्। नगरी स्वेन रूपेण ददर्श पवनात्मजम्॥
en: And that redoubtable monkey beheld the metropolis of the monarch of the Räkşasas; having for her cloth the sea; for her pendants, cow-stalls and stables; for her breasts, turrets mounted on the walls for discharging missils, decked out like a damsel; with her darkness dispelled by bright lights and the mighty monkey son to the Wind-god was met by the city in her native shape.

sa: शिरांसि सहसा जडू राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः। दशनैर्हतकर्णाश्च मुष्टिभिभिन्नमस्तकाः।। शिलाप्रहारभग्नाङ्गा विचेरुस्तत्र राक्षसाः॥
en: The Rākşasas ranged there, with their ears torn with teeth, or their heads broken by blows, or their limbs crushed with the discharge of crags.

sa: अथ वा ध्रुवमन्येभ्यो भयं परमुपस्थितम्। यदर्थमेव त्वरितैर्भवद्भिः प्रतिबोधितः॥
en: Or has a mighty fear presented itself forsooth from among others; for which I have bee speedily awakened by you?

sa: ततो दशग्रीवमुपस्थितास्ते चारा बहिनित्यचरा निशाचराः। गिरेः सुवेलस्य समीपवासिनं न्यवेदयनरामबलं महाबलाः॥
en: Then those exceedingly strong spies, always ranging outside, presenting themselves before the Ten-necked one, informed him of the forces of Rāma, stationed near mount Suvela.

sa: मोक्षितः सोऽपि रामेण वध्यमानः प्लवंगमैः। अनृशंसेन रामेण मोक्षिता राक्षसाः परे॥
en: But Rāma liberated him, who was assailed by the monkeys. And Rāma also, entertaining no enmity against them, also liberated the others, (who accompanied Sārdula).

sa: अभ्ययात्प्रत्यरिबलं पतंगा इव पावकम्। तेषां भुजपरामर्शव्यामृष्टपरिघाशनि॥
en: And whirling with their arms bludgeons and asanis, that army of Rakşasas appeared exceedingly grand.

sa: न शक्यं खल्वियं लङ्का प्रवेष्टुं वानर त्वया। रक्षिता रावणबलैरभिगुप्ता समन्ततः॥
en: O monkey, for certain you are unable to obtain entry into this Laňkā, protected by the forces of Rāvaņa, and carefully guarded on all sides.

sa: स यूपाक्षवचः श्रुत्वा भ्रातुर्युधि पराभवम्। कुम्भकर्णो विवृत्ताक्षो यूपाक्षमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing Yüpākşa's speech and hearing of the defeat of his brother, Kumbhakarņa, with his eyes whirling, spoke to him, saying..

sa: अधोमुखौ तौ प्रणतावब्रीच्छुकसारणौ। रोषगद्गदया वाचा संरब्धं परुषं तथा॥
en: And he wrathfully spoke to them, standing in humble guise with their heads hung down, harsh words faltering with passion.

sa: स दर्भसंस्तराद् गृह्य ब्रह्मास्त्रेण न्ययोजयः। स दीप्त इव कालाग्निर्जज्वालाभिमुखं खगम्॥
en: Taking a kusa off your seat you did set it on Brahma weapon. And it flamed like to the fire of desolation before that crow.

sa: गताभ्यामथ विप्राभ्यां रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। दशयोजनसाहस्रं प्रथमं तु मरुत्पथम्॥
en: Those two Brāhmaṇas having departed, Rāvana, the lord of Raksasas, proceeded, at first, by the aerial way, ten thousand leagues.

sa: रूपं तेऽनुपमं भीरु कामोन्मादकरं नृणाम्। न युक्तं तपसि स्थातुं निर्गतो ह्येष निर्णयः॥
en: Your loveliness, O timid one, is peerless, capable of maddening folk with desire. It does not behove you to lead an ascetic mode of life,-this would suit an old person.

sa: तस्य विक्रमसम्पन्नाः सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः। मन:संकल्पसदृशा निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः॥
en: He has under his command a number of mighty and courageous monkeys gifted with great prowess and quick-coursing like imagination.

sa: कृतं हनूमता कार्यं सुमहद्भुवि दुर्लभम्। मनसाऽपि यदन्येन न शक्यं धरणीतले॥
en: By Hanumān has been performed a very great deed, rare on earth, and one incapable of being even conceived by any other in the world.

sa: को विशेत्सुदुराधर्षां राक्षसैश्च सुरक्षिताम् ॥ यो वीर्यबलसंपन्नो न समः स्याद्धनूमतः।
en: Who that is not the compeer of Hanuman in strength and prowess, even enters into (Lankā) hard to subdue, and carefully guarded by the Raksasas?

sa: यदलं त्वं समाश्रित्य सीतां मे हृतवानसि। तदर्शय यथाकामं ससैन्यैश्च सबान्धवः॥
en: That force relying on which you have carried away my Sita, do you as you wish, along with your forces and friends, display the same.

sa: गत्वा परममध्वानमुपर्युपरि सागरम्। हिमवन्तं नगश्रेष्ठं हनूमन्गन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Bounding sheer over the main, you, O Hanumān, should repair to the Himavānforemost of mountains.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे जज्ञे शब्दः पुष्पकसंभवः। राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सचिवैर्मुक्तो हाहाकृतो महान्॥
en: In the meantime there arose a sound from Pus paka, and the councillors of that lord of Rākşasas cried aloud.

sa: तं यान्तमनुयान्ती सा महती हरिवाहिनी। हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे सुग्रीवेणापि पालिताः॥
en: The marching was followed by the mighty host of monkeys' and all those maintained by Sugrīva were filled with joy and betrayed demonstrations of delight.

sa: इन्द्रजित्तु तदा क्रुद्धो महातेजा महाबलः। वानराणां शरीराणि व्यधमद्रावणात्मजः॥
en: Then the exceedingly powerful Indrajit, son to Ravana, endowed with wondrous energy, pierced the bodies of the monkeys (with arrows).

sa: स तु नालीकनाराचैर्गदाभिर्मुसलैरपि। रक्षोभिः संवृतः संख्ये वानरान्विचकर्ष ह॥
en: And environed by Rākşasas in that encounter, he* poured on the monkeys nälikas and nårācas and maces and clubs.. *Indrajit.

sa: प्रगृह्य गिरिशृङ्गाणि महतश्च महीरुहान्। आसेदुर्वानरा लङ्कां मिमर्दयिषवो रणे॥
en: Then, taking up mountain-peaks and migh trees, the monkeys began to proceed towards Lankā, burning to crush Lankā in battle.

sa: ते सह्यं समतिक्रम्य मलयं च महागिरिम्। आसेदुरानुपूर्येण समुद्रं भीमनिःस्वनम्। ॥
en: There upon, passing by the mounts Sahya and Malaya and arranging their enormous host, they* by and by reached the roaring deep. *The monkey leader.

sa: अहं च नित्यशो राजन्सुग्रीवसहितस्त्वया। स्मर्तव्यः परया प्रीत्या गच्छ त्वं विगतज्वरः॥
en: And my only request to you, O king, is that you may with love remember me and Sugriva. Do you now proceed, divested of sorrow.

sa: तिष्ठेदानीं न मे जीवन्प्रतियास्यति दुर्मते। अद्य त्वां निशितैर्बाणैः प्रेषयामि यमक्षयम्॥
en: But O perverse one, stay now. Living you shall not back. To-day with my sharpened shafts shall I despatch you to the abode of Yama.

sa: तेषां निविशमानानां सैन्यसंनाहनिःस्वनः। अन्तर्धाय महानादमर्णवस्य प्रशुश्रुवे॥
en: The tumult, of that monkey-host encamped there, was heard above the roaring of the deep.

sa: भूतानि भयदर्शीनि विषमस्थानि सर्वशः। भौमाश्चैवान्तरिक्षाश्च कालज्ञप्ता भयावहाः। उत्पाता राक्षसेन्द्राणामभावाय समुत्थिताः॥
en: At the command of Kala, terrible evil omens foreshadowing the destruction of the Raksasachief began to arise on the earth well as in the sky.

sa: प्रजापतिः पुरा सृष्ट्वा अपः सलिलसंभवः। तासां गोपायने सत्त्वानसृजत्पद्मसंभवः॥
en: The lord of creatures sprang from water, first created water. And the lotus-born one generated creatures for protecting that element.

sa: बह्वेतत्कामयानस्य शक्यमेतेन जीवितुम्। यदहं सा च वामोरूरेका धरणिमाश्रितौ॥
en: This is my only consolation, for which I draw my vital breath-that myself and she breathe on the same earth.

sa: तेषां वीर्यगुणोत्साहैर्न समो राघवो रणे। प्रसह्य ते त्वया राजन्हताः समरदुर्जयाः॥
en: Rāghava is not their equal either is strength or prowess. And all those heroes, hard to repress in battle, were slain by you, O king.

sa: अग्रतस्तस्य सैन्यस्य श्रीमानरामः सलक्ष्मणः। ७९ जगाम धन्वी धर्मात्मा सुग्रीवेण समन्वितः।
en: Thereat the graceful and righteous Rāma along with Laksmana, equipped with his bow, set out in the van of the army in company with Sugriva.

sa: तानि कोटिसहस्राणि वानराणां महौजसाम्॥ बध्नन्तः सागरे सेतुं जग्मुः पारं महोदधेः।
en: And those thousands of Koțis of exceeding vigour, having constructed the bridge over the ocean, went over to the other shore of the mighty main.

sa: ततो हत्वा बलाध्यक्षान्समरे तैश्च ताडितः। अब्रवीच्च ततो योधानराजा शीघ्रं निवेद्यताम्॥ युद्धार्थी रावणः प्राप्तस्तस्य युद्धं प्रदीयताम्। वद वा न भयं तेऽस्ति निर्जितोऽस्मीति साञ्जलिः।।२७
en: And killing the generals of the forces, after having been resisted by them, he addressed the warriors, saying, 'Do you speedily acquaint your king with this "Rāvana has come here seeking battle." Do you give him fight, or say with joined hands. 'I have been defeated by you, and then you have no fear whatever?'

sa: चिन्तया तप्यसे राजन्किमर्थं मयि तिष्ठति ॥ सोऽहं शत्रुविनाशाय तव निर्यातुमुद्यतः।
en: Why, O king, while I remain, did you burn in anxiety. And I am ready to sally out for compassing the destruction of your enemies.

sa: तदेवं प्रस्तुते कार्ये प्रायश्चित्तमिदं क्षमम्। रोचये वीर वैदेही राघवाय प्रदीयताम्॥
en: Things having come to this pass, even this expiation, I fancy, is capable of removing the evil omens. Do you render back Vaidehī to Raghava.

sa: पर्वतांचूर्णयिष्यामि दारयिष्यामि मेदिनीम्॥ दीर्घकालं प्रसुप्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य विक्रमम्। अद्य पश्यन्तु भूतानि भक्ष्यमाणानि सर्वशः।। न त्विदं त्रिदिवं सर्वमाहारो मम पूर्यते॥
en: I shall crush the mountains and rive the earth. And today let all creatures as they are being eaten up, witness the prowess of Kumbhakarņa, after he has slept for a long time. Even the celestial regions do not suffice for me as my fare.

sa: स्वधीतं दत्तमिष्टं च ऐश्वर्यं परिपालितम्। आयुर्निरामयं प्राप्तं सुधर्मः स्थापितः पथि॥
en: We have studied, performed sacrifices, practised charity, and obtained riches; and attaining long health and long life, we have established sterling righteousness in our path.

sa: समानयत मे क्षिप्रमिहैताराक्षसानिति । कृत्यमस्ति महज्जाने कर्तव्यमिति शत्रुभिः॥
en: Do you speedily summon hither the Raksasas. I fancy some mighty effort has to be put forth against our foes.

sa: त्वया तु नृपशार्दूल रोषमेवानुवर्तता। लघुनेव मनुष्येण स्त्रीत्वमेव पुरस्कृतम्॥
en: O foremost of kings, being subject to ire-you did not perceive anything but womanhood in me, like an ordinary man.

sa: इयं च दण्डकारण्याद्रामस्य महिषी प्रिया। रक्षोभिश्चरितोद्देशादानीता जनकात्मजा ॥
en: Janaka's daughter and Rāma's beloved wife has been brought hither from the forest of Dandaka, the region ranged by Raksasa.

sa: परस्परं चाधिकमाक्षिपन्ति भुजांश्च पीनानधिविक्षिपन्ति। मत्तप्रलापानधिविक्षिपन्ति मत्ता चान्योन्यमधिक्षिपन्ति ॥
en: And (Raksasas) were parleying, moving about their plump arms, railing at each other; and throwing intemperate speeches at each other.

sa: निरायुधो महातेजाः केवलं नखदंष्ट्रवान्। नरान्तकमभिक्रम्य वालिपुत्रोऽब्रवीद्वचः॥
en: And weaponless himself, and furnished only with nails and teeth, Vali's son attacking Narāntaka, said.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धस्य वदनाद्यमस्य समजायत। ज्वालामाली सनिःश्वासः सधूमः कोपपावकः॥
en: Then from forth Yama's mouth there issued darted flames with his teeth mixed with smoke, the fire of his fury.

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। प्रजापतिं पुरस्कृत्य समेतास्तद्रणाजिरे॥
en: And celestials and Gandharvas and Siddhas, and the supreme saints, placing Prajāpati at their head, presented themselves at the fight.

sa: नित्यमन्योन्यसंहृष्टा व्यसनेष्वाततायिनः। प्रच्छन्नहृदया घोरा ज्ञातयस्तु भयावहाः॥
en: These terrible enemies-the kinsmen, hypocrite as they are, always take delight in one another's calamity.

sa: स वानरान्सप्त शतानि वीरः प्रासेन दीप्तेन विनिर्बिभेद। एक: क्षणेनेन्द्ररिपूर्महात्मा जघान सैन्यं हरिपुङ्गवानाम्॥
en: That hero by means of an effulgent bearded dart pierced seven hundred monkeys, and at one time the high-souled enemy of Indra slew the army of the foremost of monkeys.

sa: यथा पूर्वं गजः स्नात्वा गृह्य हस्तेन वै रजः। दूषयत्यात्मनो देहं तथानार्येषु सौहदम्॥
en: As an elephant, after being bathed, covers its body again with dust, taking it with its trunk, so is the friendship with unworthy persons.* *They afterwards forsake their former friends.

sa: सर्वैः प्लवंगैः प्रसभं निगृहीतो निशाचरः॥ गगनाद्भूतले चाशु प्रतिगृह्यावतारितः।
en: On being seized vehemently by all these monkeys, that night-ranger was brought down speedily from the sky to the earth.

sa: एवमुक्तौ ततो वीरावुभौ सुग्रीवलक्ष्मणौ। समुदाचारसंयुक्तमिदं वचनमूचतुः॥
en: Thus addressed, those two heroes-Lakşmaņa and Sugriva, spoke respectfully the following words fraught with propriety.

sa: मया हि भगवन्क्रोधात्प्रतिज्ञातं रणार्थिना। अवजेष्यामि चतुरो लोकपालानिति प्रभो॥
en: O master, from wrath I have vowed that I will, eager for encounter, O reverend one, conquer the four Lokapālas.

sa: तमात्मपञ्चमं दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः। वानरैः सह दुर्धर्षश्चिन्तयामास बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Beholding him along with four counsellors, the highly intelligent Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys, engaged in meditation along with them.

sa: राक्षसानां वधे साह्यं लङ्कायाश्च प्रधर्षणे। करिष्यामि यथाप्राणं प्रवेक्ष्यामि च वाहिनीम्॥
en: I shall lend you my might in slaying the Raksasas and devastating the city of Larkā, and shall be in the midst of Rāvana's army.

sa: देवाश्च क्रतवश्चैव क्रतूनां फलमेव च। यानि कृत्यानि लोकेषु सर्वेषु परमप्रभुः॥
en: He constitutes the gods and the sacrifices and the fruit also thereof, and he is the lord of all acts that are performed by creatures

sa: एष ते राजधर्माणां लेशः समनुवर्णितः। भूयस्ते यत्र संदेहस्तद् ब्रूहि कुरुसत्तम॥
en: I have now told you a part only of the duties of kings. Tell me, O best of Kurus, what more you wish to know.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच मेरोरथोत्तरं पार्श्व पूर्वं चाचक्ष्व संजय। निखिलेन महाबुद्धे माल्यवन्तं च पर्वतम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, O greatly intelligent one, tell me in detail about the country on the north and the east of the Meru and also about the Malyavat mountain.

sa: ऊचतू राजपुत्रीं तां पतिस्तव विशत्वपः। ततोऽम्भश्च्यवनः शीघ्रं रूपार्थी प्रविवेश ह॥
en: They then thus spoke to that princess, “Let your husband enter into water. Thereupon Chyavana with the desire of becoming handsome soon entered the water.

sa: ऋषयो ह्यत्र लम्बन्ते न हन्यामिति तानृषीन्। तपोरतान्लम्बमानान्ब्रह्मर्षीनभिवीक्ष्य सः॥
en: Having seen the holy Rishis thus suspended, he said to himself, “These Rishis of great penances must not be killed.

sa: गुरुणा त्वभ्यनुज्ञातो मनुजौघं विसृज्य तम्। विवेशान्तःपुरं राजा सिंहो गिरिगुहामिव ॥
en: Then with the permission of his spiritual guide, leaving that assembly of men, the monarch entered his inner apartment like a lion entering his den.

sa: तथेति च स राजानमुक्त्वा वेदविदां वरः। स्वयं वसिष्ठो भगवान् ययौ रामनिवेशनम्॥ उपवासयितुं वीरं मन्त्रविन्मन्त्रकोविदम्। ब्राझै रथवरं युक्तमास्थाय सुधृतव्रतः॥
en: Thereupon, saying, “So be it," that best of those versed in the Veda, the worshipful Vasiştha conversant with mantras, that one practising excellent vows, mounting a Brahma car, himself went to the residence of Rāma cognizant of mantra, for the purpose of making him fast.

sa: नेह ध्रुवं किंचिदपि प्रचिन्तयन् विद्यां लोके कर्मणो नित्ययोगात्। सूर्योदये को हि विमुक्तसंशयो भावं कुर्वीताद्य गुरौ निपातिते॥
en: Even on reflection I do not find any thing perinanent in this world on account of the eternal connection of acts. When the preceptor himself is no more who can expect that he will surely live till even today's sun-rise.

sa: इत्युक्तास्तेन ते सर्वे पार्थेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। सज्जमाशु ततश्चक्रुः स्वसिद्ध्यर्थं समुत्सुकाः॥
en: Thus addressed by Pritha's son of Pure deeds, all of them hastened their preparations with eagerness for securing their safety.

sa: एतौ वनमिदं दुर्ग वालिप्रणिहितौ ध्रुवम्। छद्मना चीरवसनौ प्रचरन्ताविहागतौ॥
en: Forsooth, these two heroes, in false guises and wearing bark, despatched by Vāli, have come here traversing the forest stronghold.

sa: भैक्ष्यचर्यां ततः प्राहुस्तस्य तद्धर्मचारिणः। तथा वैश्यस्य राजेन्द्र राजपुत्रस्य चैव हि॥
en: For a Shudra practising all these duties, as also for a Vaishya, O king, and a Kshatriya, the Bhikshu mode of life has been sanctioned.

sa: क्षीणायुः केन भवति कर्मणा भुवि मानवः। विपाकं कर्मणां देव वक्तुमर्हस्यनिन्दित॥
en: By what acts does one become shortlived on Earth? O you who are perfectly stainless, you should tell me what are the consequences of acts.

sa: ततः समापयामासुः कर्म तत् तस्य याजकाः। आस्तीकश्चाभवत् प्रीतः परिमोक्ष्य भुजङ्गमान्॥
en: The sacrificial priests then finished the rites which remained to go through. Astika, having rescued the snakes (from a fiery death) became filled with joy.

sa: कृतबुद्धिं निवासाय तत्रैव स मुनिस्तदा। भरतं केकयीपुत्रमातिथ्येन न्यमन्त्रयत्॥
en: Then the ascetic asked Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi, when he had decided for staying there, to receive his hospitality.

sa: तेषां श्रुत्वा प्रतिष्ठानं नामकर्मानुकीर्तनात्। कृत्वापि पातकं घोरं सद्यो मुच्यते मानवः॥
en: Hearing their celebrity, and on account of a recitation of their names and achievements, a man, who has committed even terrible sins, will be cleansed.

sa: अद्यैव तं गमिष्यामि देशं यत्रानुजो मम। नहि भ्रातृन्समुत्सृज्य क्षणं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥
en: This very day will I repair to that place where my younger brother is. Forsaking my brother, I forsooth dare not live for a moment.

sa: रोचते ते पितुस्तात पाण्डवैः सह संगमः। सामात्यस्य कुरुश्रेष्ठ तत् तुभ्यं तात रोचताम्॥
en: Peace, my dear friend, with the sons of Pandu is pleasing to your father and you foremost among the Kurus, may it prove pleasing to yourself along with your advisers.

sa: तत्र त्यक्त्वा शरीराणि दिवामारुरुहुः पुनः। ताश्चैवाप्सरसो भूत्वा वासुदेवमुपाविशन्॥
en: Renouncing their (human) bodies there, they re-ascended to the celestial region. Transformed into Apsaras, they approached the presence of Vasudeva.

sa: इष्वस्त्रं मम बालस्य भवतैव चतुर्विधम्। उपदिष्टं महाबाहो शिष्योऽस्मि तव भार्गव॥
en: In my childhood had you taught me the use of four kinds of arms, and I am thus your pupil, O you of Bhrigu race."

sa: अथ जित्वा मरुत्तं स प्रययौ राक्षसाधिपः। नगराणि नरेन्द्राणां युद्धकाङ्क्षी दशाननः॥
en: Having vanquished Marutta, that lord of Rākşasas the Ten-faced Răvaņa, eager for encounter, began to range the capitals of the foremost monarchs (of the earth).

sa: अस्य त्वेकमुपांशुव्रतं यदेनं कश्चिद् ब्राह्मण: कंचिदर्थमभियाचेत्तं तस्मै दद्यादयम् यद्येतदुत्सहसे ततो नयस्वैनम्' इति॥
en: But he observes a particular rule, namely he grants to a Brahmana whatever he asks from him. If you can allow him to do it, you can then take him."

sa: ततो मामब्रवीद् देवी सर्वभूतहितैषिणी। माता स्वरूपिणी राजन् किमिदं ते चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: Then did my divine mother, doing good to all creatures, in her own form say to me, O king, "what is this desired by you?

sa: स्वर्गपर्वण्यपि तथा हविष्यं भोजयेद् द्विजान्। हरिवंशसमाप्तौ तु सहस्रं भोजयेद् द्विजान्॥
en: When the Svarga Parva is reached, the Brahmanas should be left with Havishya. Upon the conclusion of the Harivansha, a thousand Brahmanas should be fed.

sa: सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि। यदा पश्यति भूतात्मा ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा॥
en: When a living creature sees his own Soul in all things, and all things in his own Soul, he is said to attain to Brahma.

sa: यजन्ते च महायज्ञैस्त्रयो वर्णाः पृथग्विधैः। युक्ताश्चाधीयते विद्यां यदा रक्षति भूमिपः॥
en: By virtue of royal protection the members of the three castes can celebrate high sacrifices and engage themselves in the acquisition of learning with attention.

sa: स कदाचिदुपाध्यायमाहोत्तङ्कः-'आज्ञापयतु भवान् किं ते प्रियमुपहरामि गुर्वर्थम्' इति॥
en: Some time after Uttanka again said to his preceptor, “Command me to bring what you wish to have as Dakshina.

sa: को हि शक्तो रणे जेतुं पाण्डवं रभसं तदा। यस्य गोप्ता जगद्गोप्ता शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः॥
en: What man is capable of conquering the mighty son of Pandu, who is protected by the Protector of the worlds, the wielder of the conch, discus and the mace divine.

sa: वर्चा नाम महातेजाः सोमपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ सोऽभिमन्युइँसिंहस्य फाल्गुनस्य सुतोऽभवत्।
en: Soma's son of great prowess, named Varshas of mighty energy became Abhimanyu, the son of Phalguna, that foremost of men.

sa: भगवन् निहताः सर्वे त्वया भूयिष्ठशो नराः। रामस्य पदमन्विच्छ तत्र गच्छाम यत्र सः॥
en: O holy one, a very large number of men has been killed by you. Turn now to where Rama has gone! We wish to go there where he has gone.

sa: भगवन् निहताः सर्वे त्वया भूयिष्ठशो नराः। रामस्य पदमन्विच्छ तत्र गच्छाम यत्र सः॥
en: O holy one, a very large number of men has been killed by you. Turn now to where Rama has gone! We wish to go there where he has gone.

sa: ममत्वं च न विन्देयुर्यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥ अन्ताश्चाकाल एव स्युर्लोकोऽयं दस्युसाद् भवेत्।
en: If the king did not protect, everything would be destroyed untimely and every part of the country would be laid waste by robbers, and everybody would fall into dreadful hell.

sa: विष्वग्लोपः प्रवर्तेत यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥ ममेदमिति लोकेऽस्मिन् न भवेत् सम्परिग्रहः। यानं वस्त्रमलङ्कारान् रत्नानि विविधानि च।
en: Ruin would befall everything if the king did not observe the duty of protection. Wicked men would by force appropriate the cars, dresses, ornaments, precious stones and other kinds of property belonging to others, if the king did not protect.

sa: वनादस्माच्च कौन्तेय वनमन्यद् विचिन्त्यताम्। निवासार्थाय यद् युक्तं भवेद् वः पृथिवीपते॥
en: O son of Kunti, O ruler of the world, think of going from this forest to another (forest) that may be fit for your abode.

sa: त्रीण्यर्पितान्यत्र शतानि मध्ये घष्टिश्च नित्यं चरति ध्रुवेऽस्मिन्। चक्रे चतुर्विशतिपर्वयोगे षड्वै कुमाराः परिवर्तयन्ति॥
en: “This wheel, the circumference of which is marked by twenty-four divisions. representing twenty-four, Lunar changes, contains three hundred and sixty spokes. It is continually set in motion by six boys.

sa: अनरण्येन तेऽमात्या मारीचशुकसारणाः। प्रहस्तसहिता भग्ना व्यद्रवन्त मृगा इव॥
en: Brought down by Anaranya, his (Ravana's) councillors Mārica, Suka, and Sarana with Prahasta, took to their heels like to dear.

sa: जुह्वतां तत्र तेषां तु मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्। स्वाध्यायेनातिमहता बभूवुः पूरिता दिशः॥
en: The whole region was as if filled with loud Vedic recitations of those Rishis of pure souls, all engaged in pouring libations of sacrificial fires.

sa: ऋषीणां बहुलत्वात्तु सरस्वत्या विशाम्पते। तीर्थानि नगरायन्ते कूले वै दक्षिणे तदा॥
en: On account of the number of the Rishis, O king, the tirthas on the southern banks of the Sarasvati all looked like towns and cities.

sa: शङ्खिनीतीर्थमासाद्य तीर्थसेवी कुरूद्वह। देव्यास्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा लभते रूपमुत्तमम्॥
en: O perpetuator of the Kuru race, going to Tirth called Shankhini and bathing in the Divitirtha man acquires great prowess.

sa: ब्रह्मद्विड भविता तं वै हनिष्यामीति भार्गव। शरणार्थं प्रपन्नानां भीतानां शरणार्थिनाम्॥
en: Becomes the destroyer of a Brahmana I shall slay him" O you of Bhrigu's race, Then, who out of fear will take refuge with me,

sa: अश्वत्थाम्नो विकर्णस्य संजस्य विविंशतेः। ज्ञातीनां चैव भूयिष्ठं मित्राणां च परंतप॥
en: And to Ashvathama, and Vikarna, and Sanjaya and Vivingshati and very much so to your cousins and also to your friends, O chastiser of foes.

sa: ततो भीतः कलिः क्षिप्रं प्रविवेश बिभीतकम्। कलिस्त्वन्यैस्तदादृश्यः कथयन् नैषधेन वै॥
en: Thereupon Kali became terrified and instantly entered into the three Vibhitaka. While Kali, thus conversing with the king of the Nishadhas, was invisible to others.

sa: प्रहरन्त्यपरे घोरा यूपानुत्पाटयन्ति च। प्रमर्दन्ति तथा चान्ये विमर्दन्ति तथा परे॥
en: Some amongst them of terrible form began to smite and strike. Some tore up the sacrificial stakes. Some began to grind and others to crush.

sa: भरतः प्रत्युवाचेदं प्राञ्जलिस्तं तपोधनम्। न सैन्येनोपयातोऽस्मि भगवन् भगवद्भयात्॥
en: Bharata replied to him, saying, “I had not come accompanied with my forces, from fear of you, O reverend Sir.”

sa: कृपणं त्वामभिप्रेक्ष्य सिद्धचारणसेविता। मया विनिहतं देवी रोदतामद्य पार्थिव॥
en: O ruler of the earth, let your mothe worshipped by Siddhas and Charanas seeing yourself slain by me, weep today.

sa: प्रतिपर्वसमाप्तौ तु पुस्तकं वै विचक्षणः। सुवर्णेन च संयुक्तं वाचकाय निवेदयेत्॥
en: Upon the conclusion of all the Parvas, the wise householder should give to the reciter a copy of the Mahabharata with a piece of gold.

sa: अन्वकुर्वन्नुलूकानां सारसा विरुतं तथा। अजाः शिवानां विरुतमन्वकुर्वत भारत॥
en: The Sarashas were heard to imitate the hooting of the owl, and goats imitated the cries, O Bharata, of Jackals.

sa: न बहूनभियुञ्जीत यौगपद्येन शात्रवान्। साम्ना दानेन भेदेन दण्डेन च पुरंदर॥ एकैकमेषां निष्पिष्य शिष्टेषु निपुणं चरेत्। न तु शक्तोऽपि मेधावी सर्वानेवारभेन्नृपः॥
en: Never attack many enemies simultaneously. By using the means of conciliation, or of gift, or of creation of disunion. O Purandara, they should be assailed one by one. The victor may treat peacefully the remnant. An intelligent king, even if competent for it, should not begin to crush all simultaneously.

sa: यथा वप्रे वेगवति सर्वतः सम्प्लुतोदके। नित्यं विवरणाद् बाधस्तथा राज्यं प्रमाद्यतः॥
en: As a rapid current ceaselessly washes away the high bank and causes large landslips, so carelessness and mistake bring about the ruination of a kingdom.

sa: ईदृशैस्तैरमात्यैश्च राजा दशरथोऽनघः। उपपन्नो गुणोपेतैरन्वशासत् वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Surrounded by such counseliors endowed with various qualities, the faultless king Dasaratha ruled the earth.

sa: क्रीडन्त्यश्च हसन्त्यश्च गायन्त्यश्चापिताः शुभम्॥ उदारसत्त्वं सत्त्वज्ञाः स्त्रियः पर्यचरंस्तथा।
en: Sporting and laughing and singing, those ladies conversant with the thoughts of all men, entertained that ascetic of noble soul.

sa: श्रीतीर्थं च समामाद्य स्नात्वा नियतमानसः। अर्चयित्वा पितॄन् देवान् विन्दते श्रियमुत्तमाम्॥
en: Going with subdued mind to the Tirtha called Sri and bathing in it and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials there, one obtains great affluence.

sa: सिद्धार्थाः पितरं वृत्तं तस्मिन् काले झुपस्थिते। प्रेतकार्येषु सर्वेषु संस्करिष्यन्ति राघवम्॥
en: Surely they are blessed that when the time shall come when the king will die, will perform the funeral rites of that descendant of Raghu.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र सुतीर्थकमनुत्तमम्॥ तत्र संनिहिता नित्यं पितरो दैवतैः सह। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत पितृदेवार्चने रतः॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति पितृलोकं च गच्छति।
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent Tirthas called Su. There the Pitris are always present with the celestials. Bathing there and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials, obtains thc fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and goes to the region of Brahma.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र पुरस्कृत्य गान्धारी च यशस्विनीम्। मातरं च पृथां धीमान् भ्रातृ॑श्च पुरुषर्षभान्॥ जनार्दनेनानुगतो विदुरेण च धीमता। युयुत्सुना च कौरव्यो युयुधानेन वा विभो॥ महता राजभोगेन पारिबहेण संवृतः। स्तूयमानो महातेजा भीष्मस्याग्नाननुव्रजन्॥
en: Placing Dhritarashtra at the head and queen Gandhari celebrated for her virtues, and his own mother Kunti and all his brothers also the highly intelligent Yudhishthira, accompanied by Krishna and wise Vidura, as also by Yuyutsu and Yuyudhana, and by his other relatives and followers forming a large train, proceeded, his praises sung the while by culogists and bards. The sacrificial fires of Bhishma were also borne in the procession.

sa: कोशसंग्रहणे युक्ता बलस्य च परिग्रहे। अहितं चापि पुरुषं न हिंस्युरविदूषकम्॥
en: And they were ever busy in replenishing the exchequer and in levying troops. And they did not cherish ill will even towards enemies, when innocent.

sa: दशाश्वमेधिकं चैव तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महीपते। तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र गच्छेत परमां गतिम्॥
en: O ruler of earth, O foremost of men, there is in that spot another Tirtha called Dashashvamedha. Bathing in it, one obtains the highest state.

sa: भूमिदानं समादद्याद् वाचकाय नराधिप। भूमिदानसमं दानं न भूतं न भविष्यति॥
en: To the reciter, O king of men, gift of land should be made. No gift like that of land could ever be or will be.

sa: गजानां भीमरूपाणां द्रवता निःस्वनो महान्। अश्रूयत यथा काले जलदानां नभस्तले॥
en: The loud noise of the rushing of dreadful elephants was then heard there, resembling the roars of the clouds in the sky in the rains.

sa: ततः कोपपरीताङ्गी पुत्रशोकपरिप्लुता। जगाम शौरि दोषेण गान्धारी व्यथितेन्द्रिया॥
en: Filled with anger and sorrow at the death of her sons, Gandhari, with agitated heart, attributed every fault to Keshava.

sa: हयौधन पादरक्षांश्च रथिनस्तत्र शिक्षिताः। शरैः सम्प्रेषयामासुः परलोकाय भारत॥
en: Well-trained car-warriors, O Bharata, with their arrows, killed a number of cavalry and infantry that urged and protected the elephants.

sa: ततः कतिपयाहःसु वृद्धो जानपदो द्विजः। मृतं बालमुपादाय राजद्वारमुपागमत्॥
en: Some days having passed in this wise-a villager, an old Brālimaņa, arrived at the palace gate with a dead boy.

sa: तथैव निहताः शूराः शेरते रुचिराङ्गदाः। द्रोणेनाभिमुखाः सर्वे भ्रातरः पञ्च केकयाः॥
en: Likewise, the five brave Kekaya brothers, adorned with beautiful Angadas, are lying on effort killed by Drona and with their faces turned towards that hero.

sa: क्षीरोदो हृदधीनां च यन्त्राणां धनुरेव च। वज्रः प्रहरणानां च व्रतानां सत्यमेव च॥
en: You are the ocean of milk among all oceans, and you the bow among instruments for hurling weapons. You are the thunder among weapons, and you are Truth among vows.

sa: बहवो बाहवश्छिन्ना नागराजकरोपमाः। उद्वेष्टन्ते विचेष्टन्ते वेगं कुर्वन्ति दारुणम्॥
en: Numerous arms, chooped off from human bodies and looking like the tusks of elephants, jumped up and moved furiously about.

sa: तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति येऽपि पापकृतो नराः। पृथूदके नरश्रेष्ठ एवमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: O foremost of men, O best of the Bharata race, bathing in the Prithudaka (even) sinful men go to heaven. Thus say all wise men.

sa: गुणा गुणेषु जायन्ते तत्रैव निविशन्ति च। एवं गुणा: प्रकृतितो जायन्ते निविशन्ति च।॥
en: Ether and other qualities originate from the qualities of Goodness, Darkness, and Ignorance, and disappear in the end in them. Thus the qualities arise from Nature and disappear in Nature.

sa: ईदृशानां सहस्राणि विशिष्टानामथो पुनः। मयैकेन निरस्तानि ससैन्यानि रणाजिरे॥
en: Thousands of such kings, well known names too, along with their armies, were stopped in the battle by me alone.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। शतक्रतोश्च संवादं नमुचेश्च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is also cited the old discourse between him of a hundred sacrifices and the Asura Namuchi,OYudhisthira.

sa: प्रणमन्तं तमुत्थाप्य सम्परिष्वज्य भूमिपः। प्रदिश्य चासनं चात्मै रामं च पुनरब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon raising Räma as he was bending down, and embracing him, and pointing out a seat, the protector of the earth again spoke to him.

sa: एष दुर्योधनो राजा पूज्यते त्रिदशैः सह। सद्धिश्च राजप्रवरैर्य इमे स्वर्गवासिनः॥
en: Here is king Duryodhana. He is adored with the celestials by these righteous men and those foremost of kings, who are now jeweilers of Heaven.

sa: स योगबलमास्थाय मामकं पार्थिवोत्तमः। शासनात् तव विप्रर्षे धुन्धुमारो भविष्यति। एवमुक्त्वा तु तं विप्रं विष्णुरन्तरधीयत॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, that best of kings will be endued with Yoga power derived from me. Commanded by you he will be the slayer of Dhundhu.” Having said this to that Brahmana Vishnu disappeared.

sa: अद्य चन्द्रोऽभ्युपगमत् पुष्यात् पूर्वं पुनर्वसुम्। श्वः पुष्ययोगं नियतं वक्ष्यन्ते दैवचिन्तकाः॥
en: To-day, before meeting Pusya, the moon has entered the Punarvasu asterism; and the astrologers say that to-morrow it will certainly be in conjunction with Pușya.

sa: नास्यापराद्धाः शेषमवाप्नुवन्ति नायं वैरं विस्मरते कदाचित्। वैरस्यान्तं संविधायोपयाति पश्चाच्छान्तिं न च गच्छत्यतीव॥
en: Those who offend him are never allowed to live; he never forgets his enemy; on come pretext or other he takes revenge; and even after that he is not pacified.

sa: एवं ते संविदं कृत्वा विबुधा ऋषयस्तथा॥ अपृच्छन् सहिताभ्येत्य वसु राजानमन्तिकात्।
en: Having thus spoken each other, the gods and the Rishis quickly approached king Vasu and asked him, saying,-0 king, with what should one celebrate sacrifices?

sa: पितुर्वधममृष्यंस्तु रामः प्रोवाच तानृषीन्। नार्हन्तीह भवन्तो मां निवारयितुमित्युत॥
en: Rama, however, unable to forgive the destruction of his father, replied to those Rishis, saying, you should not forbid me.

sa: यस्य ध्वजाचे नदतो मृदङ्गो नन्दोपनन्दौ मधुरौ युक्तरूपौ। एतं स्वधर्मार्थविनिश्चयज्ञं सदा जनाः कृत्यवन्तोऽनुयान्ति॥
en: (He) at whose flag-staff, two beautiful and sonorous tabors, Nanda and Upananda are always played upon, knows very well the propriety of his own acts. Successful men always follow him.

sa: तेषां ध्वजाचाण्यभिवीक्ष्य राजा स्वयं दुरात्मा नरपुङ्गवानाम्। जयद्रथो याज्ञसेनीमुवाच रथे स्थितां भानुमती हतौजाः॥
en: Beholding the standards of those foremost of Kurus the wicked-minded king Jayadratha, losing all heart, said to Yajnaseni, who was seated on the car and was shining in her effulgence.

sa: अथाब्रवीत् स विजयं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। भ्रातरौ ते चिरगतौ बीभत्सो शत्रुकर्शन॥
en: Then Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, said to Vijaya (Arjuna) “O Vivatsu, O tormentor of foes, your brothers (Nakula and Sahadeva) have been long out.

sa: विप्रोषितश्च भरतो यावदेव पुरादितः। तावदेवाभिषेकस्ते प्राप्तकालो मतो मम।।
en: In my opinion, during the interval that Bharata is away from the city, should your installation be effected most opportunity.

sa: सर्वे महाराज महाप्रभावाः सर्वे महाशैलनिकाशकायाः। सर्वे समर्थाः पृथिवीं क्षणेन कर्तुं प्रविध्वस्तविकीर्णशैलाम् ॥
en: All these, O mighty monarch, are of exceeding prowess, all possess persons resembling mighty mountains; and all are competent in a moment to remove and scatter the Earth with them.

sa: यक्ष उवाच मा तात साहसं कार्मिम पूर्वपरिग्रहः। प्रश्नानुक्त्वा तु माद्रेय ततः पिब हरस्व च॥
