en: The Yaksha said: O child, do not venture to do this. I have got possession of it before. O son of Madri, first answer my questions and then drink of it and carry it away.

sa: यानि यान्यत्र योग्यानि श्वो भाविन्यभिषेचने। तानि मे मङ्गलान्यद्य वैदेह्याश्चैव कारय॥
en: Do you therefore even today provide those necessary auspicious things that will be required Hur myself and Vaidehi on the occasion of the coming installation.

sa: केकया धृष्टकेतुश्च कुन्तिभोजश्च दंशितः। युक्तानीका महाराज भीष्ममेव समभ्ययुः॥
en: The Kaikeyas, and Dhrishtaketu, and Kuntibhoja, clad in mail and supported by their armies, rushed, O monarch, against Bhishma himself.

sa: महानात्मा मतिर्विष्णुर्जिष्णुः शम्भुश्च वीर्यवान्। बुद्धिः प्रज्ञोपलब्धिश्च तथा ख्यातिधृतिः स्मृतिः॥ पर्यायवाचकैः शब्दैर्महानात्मा विभाव्यते। तं जानन् ब्राह्मणो विद्वान् प्रमोहं नाधिगच्छति॥
en: The Great Soul has these synonymous words, the Great Soul, Intelligence, Vishnu, Jishnu, Shambhu of great valour, the Understanding, the means of acquiring knowledge, the means of perception, as also fame, courage, and memory. Knowing this, a learned Brahmana has never to meet with delusion.

sa: अयजच्छ्रद्धया राजा परिसंवत्सरान् शतम्। गवां शतसहस्राणि शतमश्वशतानि च॥
en: Every year, in a century, the king gave unto the Brahmanas, with due devotion, hundred thousand kine, ten thousand horses.

sa: वेदज्ञानं च ते कृत्स्नं तपश्चाचरितं महत्। पितृपैतामहं राज्यं धुर्यवद् वोढुमर्हसि॥
en: You have mastered all the Vedas. You have earned great ascetic merit. You should, therefore, bear like an ox the burden of your ancestral kingdom.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो लोकान् समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः। ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः।।३२
en: The Great One said I am (now) the full manifestation of Death, the Destroyer of the worlds. All these warriors, standing in different divisions, will cease to be, even if you do not kill them.

sa: यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः समुद्रमेवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति। तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति॥
en: As many currents of waters, flowing through different channels, roll rapidly into the ocean, so these heroes of the world enter into your blazing mouth.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच दानाद् वा सर्प सत्याद् वा किमतो गुरु दृश्यते। अहिंसाप्रिययोश्चैव गुरुलाघवमुच्यताम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said: Snake, between benevolence and truthfulness, which is more praiseworthy? And tell me as regards unenviousness and good behaviour which is the more and which is the less important.

sa: बालार्काभिमुखो बालो बालार्क इव मूर्तिमान्। ग्रहीतुकामो बालार्क प्लवतेऽम्बरमध्यगः॥
en: Being desirous of holding the newly risen sun, Hanumān, resembling it, began to leap in the middle of the welkin.

sa: य एनमभिसंरब्धं प्लवमानमवस्थितम् । प्रेक्षन्ते वानराः सर्वे स्थितं यूथपयूथपम्॥ एष राजन्सहस्राक्षं पर्युपास्ते हरीश्वरः। बलेन बलसंयुक्तो रम्भो नामैष यूथपः॥
en: This one one of immeasurable energy has innumerable troops going about, who behold this leader of leaders under unusual excitement leaping and resting (by turns). This lord of monkeys dwell near the thousand-eyed Deity; and this leader of hands, gifted with strength, is named Rambha.

sa: यथोद्दिष्टं मया प्रोक्तं सनिर्माणमिदं जगत्॥ तस्मादाश्वस कौरव्य पुत्रं दुर्योधनं प्रति।
en: I shall now tell you of the construction of the universe as narrated in the Shastras. Therefore, O descendant of Kuru, pacify your son Duryodhana.

sa: जनयामास पुत्रौ द्वावरुणं गरुडं तथा। विकलाङ्गोरुणस्तत्र भास्करस्य पुरस्सरः॥
en: She gave birth to two sons, Aruna and Garuda and the undeveloped-bodied Aruna became the fore-runner (charioteer) of the sun.

sa: स मामुवाच वेपन्तीं वरं मत्तो वृणीष्व ह। गम्यतामिति तं चाहं प्रणम्य शिरसाऽवदम्॥
en: He told me, while I was trembling at his sight, these words:-Do you ask a boon of me.' Bowing to him with my head I asked him to leave me.

sa: लक्ष्मणायाथ संहृष्टो हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः॥ शाखां चन्दनवृक्षस्य ददौ परमपुष्पिताम्।
en: Hanumăn, the son of the wind-god with great joy gave to Lakşmaņa a bough of a sandal tree, plentifully blossoming.

sa: अथातिरभसेनागाद्राहुरुत्सृज्य वासवम्। अनेन च स वै दृष्टः प्रधावशैलकूटवत्॥
en: Having left behind Indra, Rāhu, quickly went there but fled away on beholding the hugebodied Hanumān resembling a mountain summit.

sa: अपराधश्च ते नास्ति कन्याभावं गता ह्यसि। देवाश्चैश्चर्यवन्तो वै शरीराण्याविशन्ति वै॥
en: You are not a biame at all. You were restored to virginity. The deities are possessed of (Yoga) power. They are able enter human bodies.

sa: पुराणमितिहासाश्च तथाख्याऽऽनानि यानि च॥ महात्मनां च चरितं श्रोतव्यं नित्यमेव ते।
en: One should every day hear the Puranas and the histories and all the other narratives that cxist, as also the biographies of all great men.

sa: कचिन्न शूद्रेण न हीनजेन वैश्येन वा करदेनोपपन्ना। कच्चित् पदं मूर्ध्नि न परूदिग्धं कच्चिन्न माला पतिता श्मशाने॥
en: Has any Shudra, or any man of low birth, or any tribute paying Vaishya placed his dirty feet on my head (by taking her away)? Has the garland of flowers been thrown away on a burning place for dead bodies?

sa: समुद्र उवाच महर्षिर्जमदग्निस्ते यदि राजन् परिश्रुतः। तस्य पुत्रस्तवातिथ्यं यथावत् कर्तुमर्हति।॥
en: The Ocean said If you have heard, O king, of the great Rishi Jamadagni, his son is competent to duly receive you as a guest.

sa: दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च। कृत्वा वासस्य नियमं स्वयमेवात्मना पुरा॥
en: And at that time you did promise that you would live in the land of mortals for eleven thousand years.

sa: भीमार्जुनौ परित्यज्य यत्र त्वं भ्रातरावुभौ। मात्रोः साम्यमभीप्सन् वै नकुलं जीवमिच्छसि।॥
en: Disregarding both your brothers Bhima and Arjuna, you did wish for the revival of Nakula from your desire of doing good to your (step) mother.

sa: विदुरस्य शरीरं तु तथैव स्तब्धलोचनम्। वृक्षाश्रितं तदा राजा ददर्श गतचेतनम्॥
en: Meanwhile the body of Vidura continued to lean against the tree with eyes fixed. The king soon saw that life had fled out of it.

sa: विनिर्ययौ केतुमता रथेन नरर्षभः श्वेतहयेन वीरः। वरूथिना सैन्यमुखे महात्मा वधे धृतः सर्वसपत्नयूनाम्॥
en: That illustrious hero, that foremost of men, standing on his car furnished with his standard and yoked with white steeds went against the enemy's army supported by a large force.

sa: स च तानब्रवीद् वाक्यं निश्चित्य गुरुलाघवम्। मन्त्रज्ञान् मन्त्रकुशलो मन्त्रेषु परिनिष्ठितः॥
en: Ascertaining the weight and lightness of the present occasion, that one, expert in counsels and abiding by their advice spoke to the expert counsellors, saying.

sa: पाण्डुरं कार्मुकं गृह्य प्राया भरतसत्तम। पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि॥
en: And taking a white bow, went out, O best among the Bharatas with a white umbrella held over my head.

sa: यथा मां वै साधुवादैः प्रसन्नाः प्रशंसेयुः शिबयः कर्मणा तु। यथा श्येन प्रियमेव कुर्यां प्रशाधि मां यद् वदेस्तत् करोमि॥
en: O hawk, if it pleases you order me to do something which may be agreeable to you and for doing which the Shivi people may praise me and bless me in joy. I promise that I shall do whatever you will tell me to do.

sa: ततो यथादेशमुपेत्य तस्थुः पाञ्चालमुख्याः सह चेदिमुख्यैः। ततः समादेशसमाहतानि भेरीसहस्राणि विनेदुराजौ॥
en: Then thousands of drums were loudly beat on the field of battle. There rose from every quareer sounds of conchs and trumpets and lion-like shouts.

sa: एकं शतसहस्रं तु मानुषेषु प्रभाषितम्॥ नारदोऽश्रावयद् देवानसितो देवलः पितॄन्। रक्षोयक्षाशुको मान् वैशम्पायन एव तु॥ इतिहासमिमं पुण्यं महार्थं वेदसम्मितम्।
en: One lakh is current among human beings. Narada recited the Mahabharata to the gods; Asita-Devala to the Pitris; Shuka to the Rakshasa and the Yakshas; and Vaishampayana to human beings. This history is sacred, and of deep significance, and considered as equal to the Vedas.

sa: तं वै देवाः प्रत्यनन्दन्त राजन् मुनिश्रेष्ठा ऋम्भिरानचुरीशम्। तं गन्धर्वाश्चापि तस्थुः स्तुवन्तः प्रीत्या चैनं पुरुहूतोऽभ्यनन्दत्॥
en: The celestials all saluted him, O monarch, and many foremost of ascetics and Rishi adored him as the Lord of all. The Gandharvas waited on him, singing his praises, and Indra also joyfully praised him.

sa: स तु भुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम्। साधु रामेति संभाष्य स्वमाश्रममुपागमत्॥
en: And feasting on that nectar-like sweet food, Durvāsā, the foremost of Rşis, thanked Rāma and repaired to his own hermitage.

sa: कुमारानागताञ्छ्रुत्वा चिन्ताव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः॥ अवाङ्मुखो दीनमना द्वाःस्थं वचनमब्रवीत्। प्रवेशय कुमारांस्त्वं मत्समीपं त्वरान्वितः॥ एतेषु जीवितं मह्यमेते प्राणाः प्रिया मम।
en: So long Rāma was engaged poorly in anxious meditation with his crown bent downwards. Informed of the princes' arrival he commanded the warder, “Do you soon bring the princes here. My life depends upon them. They are my dearest life.

sa: न त्वामिहस्थां जानीते रामः कमललोचनः। तेन त्वां नानयत्याशु शचीमिव पुरंदरः॥
en: The lotus-eyed Rāma dose not know that you are here, and hence he has not been able to rescue you like to Purandara regaining Saci.

sa: गच्छन्नेव पथिस्थस्तु रामः प्रेष्यानुवाच ह॥ सम्भारांस्तीर्थयात्रायां सर्वोपकरणानि च। आनयध्वं द्वारकायामग्नीन् वै याजकांस्तथा॥
en: While proceeding, Rama ordered his servants on the way, saying-"Bring all the necessary articles of use for a pilgrimage. Bring the sacred fire that is at Dwaraka and our priests.

sa: त्रीणि तेजांसि नोच्छिष्ट उदीक्षेत कदाचन॥ सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ चैव नक्षत्राणि च सर्वशः।
en: One should not, while he is in an impure state, cast one's eyes on these three things, viz., the sun, the moon and the stars.

sa: गम्यतामिति तानाह यथेयं रघुनन्दनः। मानसाः कार्यकालेषु साहाय्यं मे करिष्यथ ॥
en: Then the descendant of Raghu answered, saying, Repair whither soever you will! Recurring to my memory, do you in time of need, render me assistance!

sa: रुद मा देवि शोकेन मा भूत्ते मनसोभयम्। शचीव भ; शक्रेण सङ्गमेष्यसि शोभने॥
en: Do not weep, exalted one, in sorrow. Let not fear take possession of your heart! Even as Sacī meet with Sakra, shall you, O auspicious one, meet with your lord.

sa: विक्रान्तस्त्वं समर्थस्त्वं प्राज्ञस्त्वं वानरोत्तम। येनेदं राक्षसपदं त्वयैकेन प्रधर्षितम्॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, you are brave, powerful and wise, since you had alone smitten this abode of the Rākşasas.

sa: वयमप्युपयास्यामो न त्विदानी कथंचन। समयः परिपाल्यो नो यावद् वर्षं त्रयोदशम्॥
en: We shall certainly go there, but we cannot do now. We shall have to live in the forest for thirteen years according to our pledge.”

sa: शक्र उवाच स्वर्गे लोके श्ववतां नास्ति धिष्ण्य मिष्टापूर्ते क्रोधवशा हरन्ति। ततो विचार्य क्रियतां धर्मराज त्यज श्वानं नात्र नृशंसमस्ति॥
en: Indra said There is no place in the celestial region for persons with dogs. Besides the Krodhavashas take away all the merits of such persons. Thinking of this, acts, O king Yudhishthira the just! Do you abandon this dog. There is no cruelty in this.'

sa: वर्जयित्वा तु कमलं तथा कुवलयं प्रभो॥ रक्तं शिरसि धार्य तु तथा वानेयमित्यपि।
en: Rejecting the lotus and the lily, O you of great might, one may bear on his head, however, a flower that is red, even if it be an aquatic one.

sa: कपिः श्रेष्ठ इति प्रोक्तो धर्मश्च वृष उच्यते। स देवदेवो भगवान् कीर्त्यतेऽतो वृषाकपिः॥
en: The word Kapi is said to mean supreme and Vrisha to mean righteousness; therefore that god of gods, the possessor of the illustrious qualities the Bhagas, is called Vrisha Kapi.

sa: सहस्राक्षोऽयुताक्षो वा सर्वतोऽक्षिमयोऽपि वा। यच विश्वं महत् पाति महादेवस्ततः स्मृतः॥
en: Possessed of thousand or ten thousand eyes or eyes on all sides of his body, as he ever protects the universe, he is called Mahadeva.

sa: समुद्धृताः फाल्गुनेन निमग्नाः शोकसागरे॥ ततः शिखण्डी वेगेन प्रगृह्य परमायुधम्। भीष्ममेवाभिदुद्राव रक्ष्यमाणः किरीटिना॥
en: Then from the ocean of grief in which they were sunk, they were rescued by Phalguna. Thereupon grasping an excellent weapon Shikhandin. Assailed Bhishma, being protected by the diadem-decked Arjuna.

sa: श्रुत्वा सेनापति प्राप्तं भरतं केकयाधिपः। युधाजिद्गर्गसहितं परां प्रीतिमुपागमत्॥
en: Hearing of the arrival of the Bharata with the army Gargya and Yudhajit, the king of Kekayas, were greatly delighted.

sa: वैदेही लक्ष्मणं रामं नेत्रैरनिमिषैरिव। आश्चर्यभूतान्ददृशुः सर्वे ते वनवासिनः॥
en: And struck with astonishment, those inhabitants of the woods of pre-eminent piety saw Vaidehī, Lakşmaņa and Rāma, with winkless eyes.

sa: सीते यथा त्वां वक्ष्यामि तथा कार्यं त्वयाबले। वने दोषा हि बहवो वसतस्तान् निबोध मे॥
en: Oh Sītā, Oh you of the weaker sex, Do you act up to my counsels; there are evils enough in the forest, do you learn them from me who am about to dwell in it.

sa: ये गताभिमुखं विष्णुमक्षरं पुरुषोत्तमम्। सम्पिष्टास्ते तदा युद्धे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ॥
en: And those that came forward before that best of male beings, Visnu, knowing no deterioration, were crushed in conflict by Vişnu in a different form.

sa: वेदा साङ्गोपनिषदः पुराणाध्यात्मनिश्चयाः। यदत्र परमं गुह्यं स वै देवो महेश्वरः॥
en: Whatever there is highly mysterious in the Vedas, their auxiliaries, in the Upanishads, in the Puranas and in Metaphysics, is identical with the god Maheshvara.

sa: प्राप्तचारित्रसंदेहा मम प्रतिमुखे स्थिता। दीपो नेत्रातुरस्येव प्रतिकूलासि मे दृढा ॥
en: I have suspected your character; you, (Therefore) standing before me, are distressing me like to a lamp before one who is subject to an eye-desease.

sa: पीड्यमानः क्षुधा तत्र फलमूलानि कर्षयन्। प्रातिष्ठत ततो राजा दमयन्ती तमन्वगात्॥
en: Oppressed with hunger, the king started from the vicinity of the city with the object of collecting fruits and roots while Damayanti followed him (closely).

sa: द्वे धाता च स विधाता च विश्वात्मा विश्वकर्मकृत्। सर्वासां देवतानां च धारयत्यवपुर्वपुः॥
en: He is Dhata and Vidhata, the soul of the universe and the doer of all acts of the universe. Himself formless, he is thousand and he is hundreds of thousands.

sa: यौ तावर्जुन शिष्यौ ते प्रियौ बहुमतौ सदा॥ तयोरपनयात् पार्थ वृष्णयो निधनं गताः।
en: Those two heroes who were the dear disciples of Arjuna, and who were much were course respected by him, alas, O Partha, through their fault, the Vrishnis have been destroyed.

sa: त्रिगर्ता भ्रातरः पञ्च रथोदारा मता मम। कृतवैराश्च पार्थस्ते विराटनगरे तदा॥
en: In my opinion, the five Trigarta brothers are Rathas and they were made enemies by the sons of Pritha while in the city of Virata.

sa: हा सीते लक्ष्मणेत्येवमाक्रुश्य तु महास्वनम्। ममार राक्षसः सोऽयं श्रुत्वा सीता कथं भवेत्॥
en: Mārīca has given up his ghost exclaiming aloud Ah! Sītā, Ah! Laksmana. I do not know what shall Sītā do hearing the cry? And what shall the mighty-armed Laksmana do?

sa: त्वमग्ने! सर्वभूतानामन्तश्चरसि नित्यदा। साक्षिवत्पुण्यपापेषु सत्यं ब्रूहि कवे वचः॥
en: “O Agni, you always dwell in every creature as the witness of their piety and impiety. Answer my question truthfully.

sa: अनार्याचरितं तात परस्वस्पृहणं भृशम्। स्वसंतुष्टः स्वधर्मस्थो यः स वै सुखमेधते॥
en: O son, to covet other's property is exceedingly mean. He, who is contended and is engaged in the practices of his own order, enjoys happiness.

sa: ततोऽभ्यवर्षन्त घना दिव्याः कुसुमवृष्टयः। देवदुन्दुभिघोषश्च दिक्षु सर्वासु शुश्रुवे॥
en: And the clouds poured down a pleasant shower of blossoms; and from all sides were heard sounds of celestial kettle-drums.

sa: भरतश्चाभिषिच्येत यदेतदभिषेचनम्। त्वदर्थं विहितं राज्ञा तेन सर्वेण राघव॥
en: Bharata shall be installed, Ch Rāghava, by all those articles which have been brought by the monarch for your installation.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु पतिते भूमौ गतसत्त्वे तु सारथौ! रथः प्रदुद्राव दिशः समुद्घान्तहयस्ततः॥
en: When deprived of life, the charioteer fell down on the earth, the chariot was dragged in all directions in consequence of its horses being unrestrained.

sa: तं वन्यराजो राजेन्द्रमापतन्तं निरीक्ष्य वै। बभूवान्तर्हितस्त्रासात् पुनः संदर्शनेऽभवत्॥
en: Seeing that foremost of monarchs approach, that best of beasts from fear disappeared; and then again showed himself. as an

sa: देवयान्युवाच प्रविशामि पुरं तात तुष्टास्मि द्विजसत्तम। अमोघं तव विज्ञानमस्ति विद्याबलं च ते॥
en: Devayani said : () best of Brahmanas, O father, I am satisfied. I shall now enter the Asura capital. I know your science and power of knowledge is not futile.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा परमक्रुद्धः स गदां परमाङ्गदाम्। खरश्चिक्षेप रामाय प्रदीप्तामशनि यथा ॥
en: Saying this Khara, highly enraged, hurled his mace+ provided with golden rings at Rāma, like to the blazing thunderbolt. Another reading is, plaited with gold.

sa: अस्मिन् युद्धे भीमसेन त्वयि भारः समाहितः। धूरर्जुनेन धार्या स्याद् वोढव्य इतरो जनः॥
en: In this battle, O 0 Bhimasena, the responsibility of guiding the car of war rests on you; while Arjuna will draw the car, on which will be seated other persons.

sa: धनंजयार्थे समरे पराक्रान्तस्य दारुक। श्वो नरेन्द्रसहस्राणि राजपुत्रशतानि च॥
en: When, O Daruka, I shall put forth my prowess for Arjuna's sake. Tomorrow thousands of kings and hundreds of princes.

sa: स जित्वा धनदं राम भ्रातरं राक्षसाधिपः। महासेनप्रसूतिं तद्ययौ शरवणं महत्॥
en: O Rāma, having, vanquished his brother, the lord of riches, the king of Räkşasas went to the great wood of reeds, where Mahasena was born.

sa: यादृशे च कुले जन्म सर्वराजाभिपूजिते। बन्धुमिश्च सुहृद्धिश्च भीम त्वमसि तादृशः॥
en: You along with your friend and wellwishers, are just what you ought to be, being born in such a family worshipped by all the kings.

sa: अव्यक्ताच्च महानात्मा समुत्पद्यति पार्थिव। प्रथमं सर्गमित्येतदाहुः प्राधानिकं बुधाः॥
en: From the Unmanifest, O king, originates the Greatness. The learned say this to be the first creation relating to Nature.

sa: दृष्टिं भूसङ्कटां कृत्वा वासुदेवो न्यपातयत्। अोन्नतशरीरस्य रूपमासीनृपस्य तु॥
en: Sitting on his haunches and supporting himself on his two arms, he contracted his eyebrows and looked angrily at Vasudeva.

sa: पूजां च परमां कृत्वा सोपाध्यायः सबान्धवः। प्राञ्जलिः कुशलं पृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: And having paid Viśvāmitra high homage together with his priests and friends, and with clasped hands enquired after the former's welfare, he addressed Viśvāmitra, saying.

sa: उपकारफलं मित्रं विदितं मे महाकपे॥ वालिनं तं वधिष्यामि तव भार्यापहारिणम्।
en: O mighty monkey, that the outcome of amity is good offices I am well aware of. I will slay that captor of your wife Vāli.

sa: ॐ तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः। ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा॥
en: Om, Tat, Sat, these are the threefold designation of Brahma. The Brahmanas, the Vedas and the Yajnas are all ordained in ancient time by Brahma.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच अधीतं विधिवद् दत्तं भूः प्रशास्ता ससागरा॥ मूर्ध्नि स्थितममित्राणां को नु स्वन्ततरो पया।
en: Duryodhana said I have made various studies, made presents according to the ordinance, governed the wide Earth with her seas, and trumpeted over the heads of my fees. Who is there so fortunate as myself?

sa: ह्रस्वमासाद्य संचारं नासौ विनमते क्वचित्। तं तु दृष्ट्वा यथासंगमुत्सर्पति यथासुखम्॥
en: Whenever he comes to a narrow hole, he never stoops low; rather the hole opens wide at his touch; and he easily passes through it.

sa: सान्त्वितो नैषाधेनैवं पुष्करं प्रत्युवाच तम्। पुण्यश्लोकं तदा राजन्नभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः॥ कीर्तिरस्तु तवाक्षय्या जीव वर्षशतं सुखी। यो मे वितरसि प्राणानधिष्ठानं च पार्थिव॥
en: O king, having been thus consoled by the prince of the Nishadhas, Pushkara then, with folded hands, saluted and answered that virtuous prince, saying, “O prince, let your fame be immortal; and do you live at peace for hundred years, for you have give to me both life and shelter."

sa: वंशस्ते पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ भृगूणामेव तेजसा। पौत्रस्ते भविता विप्रस्तपस्वी पावकद्युतिः॥
en: Through the energy of the Bhrigus, your grandson, O king, will be an ascetic gifted with the splendour of fire.

sa: श्रुत्वा निनादं त्वथ कौरवाणां हर्षाद् विमुक्तं सह शङ्खशब्दैः। सेनापतिः पाण्डवसृञ्जयानां पाञ्चालपुत्रो ममृषे न कोपात्॥
en: Hearing the war-cries of the Kauravas uttered in joy and the blare of their conchs, the commander of the Pandava and the Srinjaya forces, viz., the Panchala prince Dhrishtadyumna could not, from wrath, bear it.

sa: त्वं कत्थसे महाराज सत्यवादी दृढव्रतः। मम चेदं वरं कस्माद् विधारयितुमिच्छसि॥
en: You describe yourself, O mighty monarch, as speaking the truth and firm in vow. Why then do you hesitate to confer this boon on me?

sa: नूनं रामप्रभावेण वैदेह्याः सुकृतेन च। यन्मां दहनकर्मायं नादहद्धव्यवाहनः॥
en: And that bearer of sacrificial offerings has not burnt me, is owing to Rāma's power and the virtue of Vaidehi.

sa: सुखानामुचितस्यैव दुःखैरनुचितस्य च। दुःखं नामानुपश्येयं कथं रामस्य धीमतः॥
en: How shall I behold the intelligent Rāma in evil plight, who has never known suffering, and has always enjoyed felicity?

sa: इमौ राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यामि देशः साधु विधीयताम्। रमणीयो ह्यसंबाधो रमेतां यत्र धन्विनौ॥
en: I shall therefore install them on throne. O gentle man, do you find out such country where those two skilful archers may unobstructed roam about.

sa: जनिवान् सह सूर्येण सर्वेषां ज्योतिषां प्रभाः॥ चुक्षुभुर्भयभीताश्च शान्तिं चक्रुस्तथैव च। ऋषयः सर्वभूतानामात्मनश्च सुखैषिणः॥ पूषाणमभ्यद्रवत शंकरः प्रहसन्निव।
en: The splendour of the luminaries as also of the Sun was destroyed. The Rishis filled with fear became agitated and desirous of their own good and that of all other creatures, performed propitiatory rites. Then Sankara, smilingly rushed upon Pushana.

sa: वृष्णियोधाश्च ते सर्वे गजाश्वरथयोधिनः। न शेकुरावर्तयितुं ह्रियमाणं च तं जनम्॥
en: The Vrishni warriors including the infantry, the elephant-warriors, and the car-men, failed to rescue those Vrishni women who were being snatched away by the robbers.

sa: उभे पुरवरे रम्ये विस्तरैरुपशोभिते। गृहमुख्यैः सुरुचिरैर्विमानैर्बहुभिर्वृते॥ शोभिते शोभनीयैश्च देवायतनविस्तरैः। तालैस्तमालैस्तिलकैर्बकुलैरुपशोभिते॥
en: Both of them were adorned with many excellent fancy articles, picturesque houses, charming palaces and many beautiful and high Tala, Tamāla, Tilaka and Vakula trees.

sa: इमौ कुमारौ सौमित्रे तव धर्मविशारदौ। अङ्गदश्चन्द्रकेतुश्च राज्यार्थे दृढविक्रमौ॥
en: O Saumitri, your two sons, Angada and Candraketu well-versed in religions, perfectly qualified in governing the kingdom and highly powerful.

sa: यः स देवान् सगन्धर्वान् सयक्षासुरपन्नगान्। अजयत् खाण्डवप्रस्थे कस्तं युध्येत मानवः॥
en: Him who vanquished the gods along with the Gandharvas and Yakshas, and Asuras and Serpents in Khandava Prastha-who will fight against that son of Pandavas?

sa: यदा त्वहं देवयोनौ वर्तामि भृगुनन्दना तदाहं देववत् सर्वमाचरामि न संशयः॥
en: When, O son of Bhrigu's race, I live in the order of the celestials, I then indeed, act in i every respect as a celestial.

sa: ततः कपिमहानादं सह भूतैर्ध्वजालयैः। अकरोद्ध व्यादितास्यश्च भीषयंस्तव सैनिकान्॥
en: Then frightening your soldiers, the ape of Arjuna's banner with other creatures thereon, opening its mouth, uttered a terrible roar.

sa: रसाकुलं षट्पदसंनिकाशं प्रभुज्यते जम्बुफलं प्रकामम्। अनेकवर्णं पवनावधूतं भूमौ पतत्यामफलं विपक्वम्॥
en: People (in this season) live upon Inany a sweet rose-apple; and ripe mangoes, of diverse colours, being shaken by the wind, fall on the earth.

sa: संजय उवाच स्तदुत निशम्यवचः स मद्रराट्। अवहमदवपन्य वीर्यवान् प्रतिषिषिधे च जगाद चोत्तरम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing those words of Karna who was delighted at the prospect of the battle, the powerful king of Madras laughed him and said the following to check him.

sa: शुश्रूषमाणा ते नित्यं नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी। सह रंस्ये त्वया वीर वनेषु मधुगन्धिषु ॥
en: I shall sport with you, O great hero, in that forest impregnated with the fragrance of flowers, tending you constantly, having my senses subdued, and being engaged in austere performances.

sa: स कथं मम वाक्यानि श्रद्दध्याद् भूय एव तु। तथा दौत्येन सम्प्राप्तः कृष्णः पार्थहिते रतः॥
en: So also, Krishna, ever engaged in the good of the Parthas, when he came to us as an emissary, was cheated by us. Our act was exceedingly unfair. Why then, will Hrishikesha trust my words?

sa: छिद्यते ह्याततं सर्वं प्रमाणं पश्य भारत। श्रेयस्ते दुर्जनात् तात पाण्डवैः सह संगतम्॥
en: All the rank growth must be cut off; O Bharata, look at the proofs; peace with the sons of Pandu is more to your interest than union with wicked people.

sa: सर्वे कामाः स्थितास्तस्यां ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः। सारवच्च प्रभूतं च भक्ष्यं भोज्यमरिंदम॥ लेह्यं चोष्यं च पेयं च हृद्यं स्वादु मनोहरम्। पुण्डगन्धाः स्रजस्तस्य नित्यं कामफला दुमाः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, every object of desire, celestials or human, is to be found in that hall; all kinds of enjoyable articles as also sweet, juicy, agreeable and delicious things that are likeable, suckable or drinkable are all there in profusion. The garlands that are there are of the most delicious fragrance, and the trees that stand (around it) yield whatever fruits are desired.

sa: मानवानां सहस्रेषु तेषु वै शुद्धयोनिषु॥ अस्मान् न कश्चिन्मनसा चक्षुषा वाप्यपूजयत्।
en: As we stood among those thousands of men all of whom were of pure birth, no one honoured us with a glance or a nod.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशो मामचिन्त्यपराक्रमः॥ हित्वा मां बालकैः सार्धं दिशं कामप्यगात् प्रभुः।
en: Having said these words to me, Hrishikesha of inconceivable prowess, leaving me with the children, has gone away some where which I do not know.

sa: ईष्या रोषं बहिष्कृत्य भुक्तशेषमिवोदकम्। नय मां वीर विस्रब्धः पापं मयि न विद्यते॥
en: Confident do you take me with you, Oh great hero, renouncing jealousy and indignation, like to water left after drinking; there exists no sin in me that could justify forsaking.

sa: क्वचित् प्रगीता इव षट्पदौथैः क्वचित् प्रर्तृत्ता इव नीलकण्ठैः। विभान्त्यनेकाश्रयिणो वनान्ताः॥
en: Somewhere the bees are humming, somewhere the peacocks are dancing-somewhere are raging the infuriated elephants and in this way the forest-land has assumed diverse appearances.

sa: तयोः संवदतोरेवं तदा पाण्डवयोर्द्वयोः। आजगाम महायोगी व्यास: सत्यवतीसुतः॥
en: When the Pandavas were talking one another, there came to that place the great ascetic Vyasa, the son of Satyavati.

sa: उत्थानहीनो राजा हि बुद्धिमानपि नित्यशः। प्रधर्षणीयः शत्रूणां भुजङ्ग इव निर्विषः॥
en: The king, who is shorn of exertion, even if endued with intelligence, is always defeated by foes like a snake that is shorn of poison.

sa: (सम्पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमं पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम्। रामस्य ध्यायती वक्त्रं पञ्चत्वं कृपणा गता।।
en: (Ever) contemplating Rāma's countenance, resembling the full Moon, with eyes like lotusleaves, she, exercised with sorrow, has breathed her last.

sa: पुरा प्राकारमायाति क्षिप्रमेकतरं कुरु। सीतां वापि प्रयच्छाशु युद्धं वापि प्रदीयताम्॥
en: He draw nigh to the wall. Therefore, do one of these things in preference to the other, either render back Sītā, or give him battle.

sa: ततस्तस्य गिरेः शृङ्गमास्थाय स खगोत्तमः। भक्षयामास गरुडस्तावुभौ गजकच्छपौ॥
en: Then the best of birds sat on the summit of that mountain and ate both the elephant and the tortoise.

sa: तथात्र प्रतिपत्स्यापि ज्ञात्वा तेषां बलाबलम्। अवश्यं खलु संख्यानं कर्तव्यं युद्धमिच्छता।।१८
en: Having ascertained their strength and weakness, I shall in this matter adopt my course. Those who wish for fight, certainly take account of all this.

sa: तप्त्वा वर्षसहस्राणि चरित्वा तप उत्तमम्। एकपादाः स्थिताः सम्यक् काष्ठभूताः समाहिताः॥
en: Having practised penances for thousands of years and acquired a great ascetic merit, we again stood on only one foot like fixed rods of wood.

sa: शृङ्गाणि च व्यशीर्यन्त गिरेस्तस्य समन्ततः। मणिकाञ्चनचित्राणि शोभयन्ति महागिरिम्॥
en: And the peaks of that great mountain, decked with gems and gold, were loosened and fell down on all sides.

sa: इति ब्रवाणां तमहं रामं परपुरंजयम्। प्रणम्य शिरसा राममेवमस्त्वित्यथाब्रुवम्॥
en: To Rama the conquered of enemies towns who thus said then I bowed my head and said "Be it so."

sa: ते बलेन वयं राजन् महता चतुरङ्गिणा। प्रमथ्य दुपदं शीघ्रमानयामेह पाण्डवान्॥
en: O king, therefore, without any further delay let us with our large army of four kinds of troops vanquish Drupada and bring here the Pandavas.

sa: न हि जातो न जायेयं न जनिष्ये कदाचन। क्षेत्रज्ञः सर्वभूतानां तस्मादहमजः स्मृतः॥
en: I was never born. I never take birth. Nor shall I ever be born. I am the Soul of all creatures. Hence I pass by the name of Aja (unborn).

sa: क्रुद्धस्य भीमसेनस्य प्रेक्षितुं मुखमाहवे। इदं संनिहितं तात समग्रं पार्थिवं बलम्॥
en: To look at the face of Bhimasena when exercised by anger in battle field. This entire assembled army of the earth is at your elbow.

sa: चा नात्पर्ततस्यैव राणा देवस्य कम्पिताः। चचाल पार्वती चापि तदाश्लिष्टा महेश्वरम्॥
en: And in consequence of the mountain shaking the attendants of the deity (dwelling in it) also shook. And Pārvatí also trembled and embraced Mahesvara. as

sa: नप्ता शक्रस्य दुर्धर्षो बलवानङ्गदो युवा। मैन्दश्च द्विविदश्चोभौ बलिनावश्विसंभवौ॥
en: The irrepressible and youthful Angada is the grandson of Śakra. And the lusty Mainda and Dvivida are sprung from Aśvi.

sa: विसृज्य कन्याः काकुत्स्थ राजा त्रिदशविक्रमः॥ मन्त्रज्ञो मन्त्रयामास प्रदानं सह मन्त्रिभिः। देशे काले च कर्तव्यं सदृशे प्रतिपादनम्॥
en: Then dismissing his daughters, the king endowed with the prowess of celestials, and versed in counsel, began to consult with his counsellors about the bestowal of his daughters, in respect of time and place and person and equability of lineage.

sa: मैथिलस्य नरश्रेष्ठ जनकस्य भविष्यति। यज्ञः परमधर्मिष्ठस्तत्र यास्यामहे वयम्॥
en: A highly meritorious sacrifice, O foremost of men, is to be celebrated by Mithila's lord, Janaka. Thither shall we repair.

sa: केनायुर्लभते दीर्घ कर्मणा पुरुषः प्रभो। तपसा वापि देवेश केनायुर्लभते महत्॥
en: By what deeds does a man succeed, O powerful deity, in acquiring a long life? By what penances also does one acquire a long life?

sa: क्रन्दन्तः समदृश्यन्त तृषिता जीवितेप्सवः॥ तृषा परिगताः केचिदल्पसत्त्वा विशाम्पते।
en: O king, some having but little strength, and lying on the field of battle asked for water from excessive thirst.

sa: मान्युवाच विलपन्त्या मया देवि वार्यमाणेन चासकृत्। आत्मा न वारितोऽनेन सत्यं दिष्टं चिकीर्षणा॥
en: Madri said : Sister, with tears in my eyes, I resisted the king, but he could not control himself, as if he was bent upon making the Rishi's curse true.

sa: विलीयमानैर्विहगैनिमीलद्भिश्च पङ्कजैः। विकसन्त्या च मालत्या गतोऽस्तं ज्ञायते रविः॥
en: The setting of the Sun is announced by the birds taking to their nests, lotuses growing pale and Málatis blossoming.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एवमुक्ता भगवता मुनयस्ते समभ्ययुः। मुक्त्वा शाखां गिरिं पुण्यं हिमवन्तंतपोऽर्थिनः॥
en: Sauti said: The great ascetics, having been thus addressed by the illustrious Kashyapa, quitting the bough, went to the sacred Himalayas to observe ascetic penances.

sa: तर्जयन्ति च संहृष्टास्तत्र तत्र परस्परम्। आदश्य दशनैश्चापि क्रोधात् सरदनच्छदम्॥ भृकुटीकुटिलैर्वक्त्रैः प्रेक्षन्ति च परस्परम्। अपरे क्लिश्यमानास्तु शरार्ता व्रणपीडिताः॥ निष्कूजाः समपद्यन्त दृढसत्त्वा महाबलाः। अन्ये च विस्थाः शूरा स्थमन्यस्य संयुगे।॥ प्रार्थयाना निपतिताः संक्षुण्णा वरवारणैः। अशोभन्त महाराज सपुष्पा इव किंशुकाः॥
en: There were some, who, lying on those places where they lay, roared in joy and bitting from wrath their own lips with their teeth, looked at one another with faces rendered fearful by the contraction of their eye-brows. Others, possessing great strength and tenacity, wounded with arrow, remained perfectly silent smarting under their pains. Other brave carwarriors, deprived of their own cars in battle and thrown down and wounded by huge elephants, asked to be taken up on the cars of others. O king, many looked beautiful like blossoming Kinshukas.

sa: सत्यत्यागात् तु मात्सर्यमहितानां च सेवया। एतत् तु क्षीयते तात साधूनामुपसेवनात्॥
en: Malice springs from the casting off of truth and indulgence in wickedness. This vice, O child, disappears when one waits upon the wise and good.

sa: अत्रेश्चैवौरसः श्रीमान् राजा सोमश्च वीर्यवान्। सहस्रं यश्च दिव्यानां युगानां पर्युपासिता॥
en: Atri had another son born of his lions, viz., the handsome and princely Soma of great power. He practised penances for a thousand divine cycles.

sa: यदि वाप्यस्पृशन्त्या मे स्पर्श जानासि कञ्चन। ज्ञानं कृतमबीजं ते कथं तेनेह भिक्षुणा॥
en: If, despite this, you still feel my touch, how can it be believed that through the instructions of the mendicant Panchashika, your knowledge has become disassociated from the sensual objects.

sa: कृतः पुरुषकारस्तु दैवमेवानुवर्तते। न दैवमकृते किंचित् कस्यचिद् दातुमर्हति॥
en: Man's powers, if properly applied only follow his Destiny, but Destiny alone cannot produce any good where Exertion is wanting.

sa: कथं तस्य समुत्पत्तिर्यतो दैवं प्रवर्तते। एवं त्रिदशलोकेऽपि प्राप्यन्ते बहवो गुणाः॥
en: How does Karma originate, if Destiny is the principal motive power of human action? By this means, many virtues are accumulated in the celesiial regions.

sa: पुरूरवाश्च राजर्षिर्द्विजैरभिहितः पुरा। ऐल इत्यभिविख्यातः स्वर्गं प्राप्तो महीपतिः॥
en: The royal sage Pururavas, well known as the descendant of lla, attained to heaven through the intercession of the Brahmanas.

sa: सागरान् सरितः शैलान् काननानि च सर्वशः। सर्वमेतन्नरः शक्र वसुधां ददत्॥
en: The person who makes a gift of earth is said to make gifts of everything, that is, of seas and rivers and mountains and forests.

sa: कश्चित् क्षुद्रसमाचारः पृथिव्यां कालसम्मितः। विचचार महारण्ये घोरः शकुनिलुब्धकः॥
en: A wicked and dreadful fowler, resembling the Destroyer himself, used in days of yore to wander through the great wilderness.

sa: भीष्म उवाच मृगयां विचरन् कश्चिद् विजने जनकात्मजः। वने ददर्श विप्रेन्द्रमृषि वंशधरं भृगोः॥
en: Bhishma said Once on a time a king of Janaka's family while roaming in the uninhabited forest in pursuit of deer, saw a superior Brahmana or Rishi of Bhrigu's race.

sa: न भुक्के मय्यभुक्ते या नास्नाते स्नाति सुव्रता। नातिष्ठत्युपतिष्ठेत शेते च शयिते मयि॥
en: Practising most excellent vows, she never eats before I eat, and never bathes before I bathe. She never sits before I sit down, and never lies before I lie down.

sa: न शृणोति न चाघ्राति न रंस्यति न पश्यति। न च स्पर्श विजानाति न संकल्पयते मनः॥ न चाभिमन्यते किंचिन्न न बुध्यति काष्ठवत्। तदा प्रकृतिमापनं युक्तमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: When one does not hear, and smell and taste, and see; when one does not feel any touch; when one's mind is perfectly free from every purpose; when one is not conscious of any thing, when one cherishes no thought, when one becomes like a piece of wood, then is he called by the wise to be in perfect Yoga.

sa: अभिमन्यत्यसम्बोधात् तथैव त्रिविधान् गुणान्। सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव धर्मार्थो काम एव च॥
en: On account of his being invested with Ignorance, the Soul adopts the different qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance, and Righteousness and riches and pleasure.

sa: परत्रगामिकस्य ते कृताकृतस्य कर्मणः। न साक्षि आत्मना समो नृणामिहास्ति कश्चन॥
en: There is no witness, of men who have gone to the next world, better than the soul, of all acts done and undone in life.

sa: वायुयोतिरथाकाशमापोऽथ पृथिवी तथा। शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धस्तथैव च॥
en: This fourth creation consists of Wind and Light and Ether and Water and Earth, with their properties of sound, touch, form, taste, and scent. arose

sa: सांख्या राजन् महाप्राज्ञा गच्छन्ति परमां गतिम्। ज्ञानेनानेन कौन्तेय तुल्यं ज्ञानं न विद्यते॥
en: The Sankhyas, O king, are gifted with great wisdom. They acquire the highest end by means of this kind of knowledge. There is no knowledge that is equal to this.

sa: इदं निदर्शनं मया तवेह पुत्र साम्प्रतम्। स्वदर्शनानुमानतः प्रवर्णितं कुरुष्व तत्॥
en: I impart to you these lessons, O son, that are all at one with the scriptures I follow. Do you, therefore, seek to acquire virtue.

sa: अत्रापि तत्त्वं परमं शृणु सम्यड्मयेरितम्। बुद्धिश्च परमा यत्र कापिलानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: For all that, hear what the truth is as explained by me. The great followers of Kapila have set their keen understandings on this point.

sa: आकाशगमने चैव विहृताहं त्वया सुखम्॥ रमामि स्म पुरा कान्त तन्मे नास्त्यद्य किञ्चन।
en: I was also made happy by you while passing with you through the skies! I used to sport with you before, O dear husband, but where are those joys now.

sa: यस्य नोपहता वुद्धिर्निश्चये ह्यवलम्बते। स्वर्गे कृतावकाशस्य नास्ति तस्य महद् भयम्॥
en: That man whose understanding is not firm and which is directed to Brahma and who has attained to heaven, becomes freed from a great fear.

sa: ब्राह्मणान् भरतश्रेष्ठ सततं ब्रह्मवादिनः। मार्कण्डेयः पुरा प्राह इति लोकेषु बुद्धिमान्॥
en: The Brahmanas, O chief of the Bharatas, are always Utters of Brahma. The intelligent Rishi Markandeya gave vent to these words in days of yore.

sa: भीष्म उवाच श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्याः स विप्रः प्राञ्जलिः स्थितः। अनुज्ञातस्तया चापि स्वगृहं पुनराव्रजत्॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of hers, the twiceborn Ashtavakra joined his hands respectfully. He then begged the lady for her permission to return. Getting the permission he sought, he returned to his own hermitage.

sa: तपोमूलमिदं सर्वं यन्मां पृच्छसि पाण्डवः तदिन्द्रियाणि संयम्य तपो भवति नान्यथा॥
en: All this that you have asked has penances for its root. That penance, again, O son of Pandu, originates from the subjugation of the senses.

sa: उवाच चैवं भगवांस्त्र्यम्बकः प्रहसन्निव। एवंविधस्ते तनयो द्वैपायन भविष्यति॥
en: Smiling with pleasure, the three-eyed god addressed him and said,-O Island-born one, you will have a son after your heart.

sa: अथ रूपं परं राजन् बिभ्रती स्वेन तेजसा। घृताची नामाप्सरसमपश्यद् भगवानृषिः॥
en: While thus engaged, the illustrious Rishi, O king, saw the . Apsara Ghritachi, who, on account of her energy, was then possessed of great beauty.

sa: व्यवसायं समाश्रित्य सहायान् योऽधिगच्छति। न तस्य कश्चिदारम्भः कदाचिदवसीदति॥
en: Depending on earnest endeavour and equipped with proper aids, he who undertakes to accomplish his tasks never meets with failure.

sa: रुधिरस्येव ते गन्धः शवस्येव च दर्शनम्। अशिवः शिवसंकाशो मृतो जीवन्निवाटसि॥
en: Your body smells like blood. You look like a corpse. Though impure, you appear as pure, and though dead you move like a living being!

sa: अनामयं च राजेन्द्र शुकः सानुचरस्य ह। अनशिष्टस्तु तेनासौ निषसाद सहानुगः॥
en: Indeed, O king, Shuka asked about the welfare of the king's followers and officers also. Receiving Shuka's permission, Janaka sat down with all his followers.

sa: निश्चितो न चापि मृत्युः पुरुषं प्रतीक्षते। सदा हि धर्मस्य क्रियैव शोभना यदा नरो मृत्युमुखेऽभिवर्तते॥
en: There is no fixed time for the acquisition of virtue. Death waits for no man. When man is constantly running towards the jaws of Death, the doing of pious deeds is proper at all times.

sa: कथं न विप्रणश्येम योनितोऽस्या इति प्रभो। कुर्वन्ति धर्मं मनुजा: श्रुतिप्रामाण्यदर्शनात्॥
en: Men always perform righteous acts, O lord, guided by the authority of the Shrutis, so that they may not deviate from the status of humanity.

sa: जातमन्वेति मरणं नणामिति विनिश्चयः। अन्तवन्ति हि कर्माणि सेवन्ते गुणतः प्रजाः॥
en: Death follows birth in all men. This is settled. Creatures, influenced by the qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance, pursue acts which have an end.

sa: इमं लोकं विमुच्य त्वमवाङ्मूर्द्धा पतिष्यसि। अशाश्वतीः शाश्वतीश्च समाः पापेन कर्मणा॥
en: Leaving this world, you shall have to fall (into hell) with head downwards and remain in that posture for numberless years for your sinful deeds.

sa: ब्राह्मणा: क्षत्रिया वैश्यास्त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः। अत्र तेषामधीकारो धर्मेषु द्विपदां वर॥
en: Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, and Vaishyas,these are the three twice-born orders, They have all an equal right to the performance of these dutics, O foremost of men.

sa: मर्त्यलोके च राजानो ये चान्ये गृहमेधिनः। महाकुलेषु दृश्यन्ते तत् सर्वं तपसः फलम्॥
en: In this world of men, they who are kings and those others who are householders born in high families, have all become what they are on account of their penances.,

sa: शक्त्यां तु कम्प्यमानायां विष्णुना बलिना तदा॥ मेदिनी कम्पिता सर्वा सशैलवनकानना।
en: When the dart was being thus shaken by the highly powerful Vishnu, the whole Earth with her mountains, forests, and seas, shook with the dart.

sa: ततो निवेदयामास पित्रे सर्वमशेषतः। शुको जनकराजेन संवादं प्रीतमानसः॥
en: With great cheerfulness he then described in full to his father all the particulars of his conversation with king Janaka.

sa: सप्तर्षीणामथोर्ध्वं च विपृथु म पार्थिवः। राजानः क्षत्रियाश्चैव मण्डलेषु पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: After the seven Rishis came king Viprithu and many other kings, all belonging to the Kshatriya order for separately ruling separate classes of human beings.

sa: इष्टं किल गिरौ स्थानं तद्दिव्यमिति शुश्रुम। नित्यं संनिहितो देवस्तथा ते पार्षदाः स्मृताः॥
en: That charining spot on the mountains, we have heard, is the favourite abode of the great god. It is said that great god as his companions are always present there.

sa: ततः क्रोधाभिभूतानां वृत्तं लज्जासमन्वितम्। ह्रीश्चैवाप्यनशद् राजंस्ततो मोहो व्यजायत॥
en: When men thus became overwhelmed with anger, modesty and shame disappeared from them, and then they were possessed by carelessness.

sa: ब्रह्मघोषैविरहितः पर्वतोऽयं न शोभते। रजसा तमसा चैव सोमः सोपप्लवो यथा॥
en: Alas, destitute of Vedic sound, this mountain has lost its beauty, as the Moon shorn of splendour when possessed by Rahu or covered with dust.

sa: तथा कश्चिल्लभेत् सिद्धो मुनिर्वा देवतापि वा। कृपणानामनुक्रोशं कुर्याद् वो रुदतामिह॥
en: Similarly, in your case also, some sage or god may be willing to grant your desire and show mercy to you that are crying piteously.

sa: मृते वा त्वयि जीवे वा यदा भोक्ष्यति वै जनः। स्वकृतं ननु बुद्ध्वैवं कर्तव्यं हितमात्मनः॥
en: When on account of the fruits of their own acts your relatives can maintain themselves in this world whether you live or die, thinking of this you should do what is for your own wellbeing.

sa: स्वयमुत्पद्यते जन्तुः स्वयमेव विवर्धते। सुखदुःखे तथा मृत्यु स्वयमेवाधिगच्छति॥
en: A living creature takes birth by himself, and, grow by himself, and acquires happiness and misery, and death by himself.

sa: आह मां भगवानेवं शिखण्डी शिवविग्रहः। तदवाप्तं च मे सर्वं प्रसादात् तस्य धीमतः॥
en: Thus did the illustrious and crested god of auspicious form said this to me. Through the favour of that god of great intelligence I got all that He had said.

sa: अगाधाचाप्रतिष्ठाश्च गतिमन्तश्च नारद। अन्धा जडाश्च जीवन्ति पश्यास्मानपि जीवतः॥
en: You see, O Narada, the illiterate, the destitute, the prosperous, the blind, idiots and madmen, and ourselves also, all live.

sa: घोरानपि दुराधर्षान् नृपतीनुग्रतेजसः। आक्रम्याददते रोगाः पशून् पशुगणा इव॥
en: Like larger animals attacking smaller ones, diseases are seen to attack even dreadful kings of fierce energy and invincible prowess.

sa: परं भावं हि काङ्क्षामि यत्र नावर्तते पुनः। सर्वसङ्गान् परित्यज्य निश्चितो मनसा गतिम्॥
en: I wish to come by that condition of existence whence there is no return! Renouncing all kinds of attachments, arrived at certainty by mental retrospection, I shall acquire that end.

sa: उक्ताश्च ते राजधर्मा आपद्धर्माश्च भारत। विस्तरेण महाराज किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: I have, O Bharata, described to you the duties of kings and ethics of con-in detail. What else, O king, do you wish to hear.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच भवतोऽपि सुराः सर्वे भागं दास्यन्ति वै प्रभो। क्रियतां प्रतिसंहारः सर्वदेवेश्वर त्वया॥
en: O powerful one, the deities will henceforth give you a share of the sacrificial offerings! O Lord of all the gods, let this anger of yours be withdrawn by you.

sa: उक्ताश्च ते राजधर्मा आपद्धर्माश्च भारत। विस्तरेण महाराज किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: I have, O Bharata, described to you the duties of kings and ethics of con-in detail. What else, O king, do you wish to hear.

sa: नन्दी च भगवांस्तत्र देवस्यानुमते स्थितः। प्रगृह्य ज्वलितं शूलं दीप्यमानः स्वतेजसा॥
en: The illustrious Nandi stood there obeying the great god, shining with his own energy and armed with a lance that resembled a flame of fire.

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् पदे नित्ये निर्गुणे लिङ्गवर्जिते। ब्रह्मणि प्रत्यतिष्ठत् स विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: He then lived in that eternal station which is shorn of attributes, freed from every indication, that is, in Brahma, shining like a smokeless fire.

sa: न बभासे सहस्रांशुर्न जज्वाल च पावकः। ह्रदाश्च सरितश्चैव चुक्षुभुः सागरास्तथा॥
en: The Sun seemed at that moment to be shorn of effulgence. Fire refused to burn forth. The lakes and rivers and seas were all moved.

sa: दमेन सदृशं धर्मं नान्यं लोकेषु शुश्रुम। दमो हि परमो लोके प्रशस्तः सर्वधर्मिणाम्॥
en: We have not heard that there is any other duty in all the worlds equal to self-control. Self-control, according to all virtuous persons, is the highest virtues in this world.

sa: ज्ञात्वा गृहीतं शक्रं स द्विजप्रवरवध्यया।॥ ब्रह्मा स चिन्तयामास तदा भरतसत्तम।
en: Knowing that Indra was possessed by the sin of Brahmanicide, Brahman began to think, 0 best of the Bharatas, (of the measures for freeing him).

sa: आचारानिह सत्यस्य यथावदनुपूर्वशः। लक्षणं च प्रवक्ष्यामि सत्यस्येह यथाक्रमम्॥
en: I shall now tell you the forms of Truth one after another, and its characteristic marks also in due order.

sa: प्राप्यते च यथा सत्यं तच्च श्रोतुमिहार्हसि। सत्यं त्रयोदशविधं सर्वलोकेषु भारत॥
en: You should hear also as to how Truth may be won. Truth, O Bharata, as it exists in all the world, is of thirteen sorts.

sa: भीष्म उवाच त्रयोदशैतेऽतिबलाः शत्रवः प्राणिनां स्मृताः। उपासन्ते महाराज समन्तात् पुरुषानिह॥
en: Bhishma said These thirteen vices are known as very powerful enemies of all creatures. These, O king, approach men and tempt them from all sides.

sa: प्रजाविसर्गं च सुखेन काले प्रत्येत्य देवेषु सुखानि भुक्त्वा। सुखेन संयास्यथ सिद्धसंख्यां मा वो भयं भूद् विमलाः स्थ सर्वे॥
en: Living happily as long as the creation lasts, all of you at the next new creation will be admitted among the gods, and enjoying all sorts of happiness you will at last be coloured among the Siddhyas! Let no fear be yours. Be you cheerful.

sa: तथा शैलालयो राजा भगदत्तपितामहः। तपोबलेनैव नृपो महेन्द्रसदनं गतः॥
en: Similarly, king Shailya, the grandfather of Bhagadatta, attained to the region of Indra by the power alone of his penances.

sa: कर्मणा स्वनुरक्तानि विरक्तानि च दानव। यथा कर्मविशेषांश्च प्राप्नुवन्ति तथा शृणु।॥
en: Listen, O Danava, by what means creatures attached to acts and those unattached to them get at the causes bringing on their respective states mind.

sa: भीष्म उवाच मोक्षधर्मेषु निरतो लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः। प्राप्नोति परमं स्थानं यत् परं प्रकृतेऽवम्॥
en: One who is devoted to the religion of Liberation, abstemious in diet, and the master of his senses, attains to that high place which is above Prakriti and is unchangeable.

sa: पितोवाच कथमभ्याहतो लोकः केन वा परिवारितः। अमोघाः काः पतन्तीह किं नु भीषयसीवमाम्॥
en: The sire said How is the world attacked?-By what is it besieged? What are those irresistible things that are falling on all sides? Do you frighten me with your words?-
